notice: 范围依据 Test 1 Scope.docx，页码按原 PPT 物理页序。英文正文和讲者备注保留原意；中英学习解读、校核说明及模拟题为辅助学习内容。模拟题不是教师原题，练习时间和分值由本站设置，不代表正式考试。图像 OCR 未逐字校对，应以原图为准。

corrections.text: 学校类型这个例子有歧义：学校机构类别可作名义变量，教育阶段则可以排序。判断测量尺度时先说明变量的实际含义。
备注中的 HER 按上下文应为 EHR（electronic health record）。原文仍予保留。
42–44 页采用 excess kurtosis（正态基准 0），52 页代码未减 3，采用原始四阶矩尺度（正态总体基准 3；有限样本估计另有差异）。峰度须先辨认定义，不能用峰度判断标准差。
这些页的备注重复了 BMI t 检验表述。学习解读依照各页实际题目、图像及输出校核，原始备注单独保留。
p ≥ α 时应写 fail to reject H₀（未能拒绝原假设），不能写证明无关联；显著差异也不能单独验证诊断或证明因果。
factor 明确指定类别及参照组。二元变量以 0/1 等数字编码并带截距时也可拟合等价组间差异，不能笼统断言所有数值编码均使模型无效。
这些页重复了输出文件夹备注。实际学习重点结合本页模型、输出和诊断图解释。
残差图和 Scale-Location 图提供诊断证据，不能证明假设必然成立。应写 broadly consistent with / no clear evidence against，并检查弯曲或扩散趋势。

studyNotes.title: Data → Information → Knowledge → Action
studyNotes.explanationZh: 数据是单独的观察值；信息把数据组织并加入背景；知识根据证据解释信息；行动把解释转成决定。老师备注用爽约说明：120人爽约→某社区爽约增加→交通可能是障碍→提供交通券及晚间门诊。知识阶段含判断与假设，仍需检验证据。
studyNotes.simpleEn: Data are observations. Information adds context. Knowledge explains the pattern. Action uses the explanation to make a decision.
examFocus: 四阶段定义及顺序
能把同一案例的四句话分类
把可能解释与已证实因果分开
studyNotes.pitfall: “交通可能是障碍”是解释，不能仅凭爽约人数确定。

studyNotes.title: Health data beyond clinical records
studyNotes.explanationZh: 健康数据不只包含诊断和药物，还包括行为、个人体验、社会经济情况、环境、政策，以及服务可及性与质量。住房、食物、交通、污染及信任都可能影响健康，所以公共卫生问题常需多种来源。
studyNotes.simpleEn: Health data include clinical care, behaviour, experience, social conditions, the environment and access to care.
examFocus: 列举非医疗健康数据
说明社会条件如何影响健康
studyNotes.pitfall: 没有病历记录不代表没有健康需求。

studyNotes.title: Unit of analysis
studyNotes.explanationZh: 先问每一行代表什么：一个人、一次就诊、一家医院、一个社区，或一天/事件。分析单位必须符合研究问题。某县的平均特征不能自动套到县内每个人；一个患者多次就诊也不能直接当成多个独立患者。
studyNotes.simpleEn: The unit of analysis is what one row represents. Match it to the research question.
examFocus: 辨认人、就诊、机构和社区单位
说明群体数据推论个人的限制
studyNotes.pitfall: 把100次就诊误写成100名患者，或把社区平均值当成每个人的数值。
studyNotes.visualExplanation: 原图是一条表格标题截图，重点是用列及每行内容判断记录单位。

studyNotes.title: Quantitative data and numeric labels
studyNotes.explanationZh: 定量数据表达数量，包括次数、血压、身高、金额、等待时间、率与百分比。数字外观不保证它是数量：邮编、病人ID、病历号通常是标签，取平均没有实际意义。
studyNotes.simpleEn: Quantitative data measure counts or amounts. A patient ID is a label even when it contains digits.
examFocus: 定量变量例子
区分数量与数字编码
studyNotes.pitfall: 不要计算患者编号的平均数来描述健康。

studyNotes.title: Discrete versus continuous
studyNotes.explanationZh: 离散数据是可数的整数，如0、1、2次住院；连续数据是测量尺度上的值，如37.2°C体温。记录经过四舍五入仍可来自连续变量；必须写清单位和精度。
studyNotes.simpleEn: Discrete data are counts. Continuous data are measurements. Rounding a measurement does not turn it into a count.
examFocus: 次数与测量的差别
四舍五入不改变原变量性质
单位与精度
studyNotes.pitfall: 个人不可能有1.6次住院，但一组人的平均住院次数可以是1.6。

studyNotes.title: Qualitative data
studyNotes.explanationZh: 定性数据包括访谈文字、感受、经历、焦点小组讨论和开放式答案。老师特别指出它可以科学而严谨：统一访谈流程、编码框架、归纳主题、多位复核者，以及记录结论如何得出。
studyNotes.simpleEn: Qualitative data describe experiences and meaning. Clear coding and review can make the analysis rigorous.
examFocus: 定性数据例子
解释定性研究如何保持严谨
studyNotes.pitfall: 文字资料不等于主观随意；把文字编码成数字也不自动产生可平均的数量。

studyNotes.title: Nominal, ordinal and binary categories
studyNotes.explanationZh: 名义变量只有类别且没有自然顺序，如保险类型；有序变量有顺序，但级距不一定相等，如poor/fair/good/excellent；二元变量有两类，如yes/no。课件把primary/secondary/university作为school type的名义例子，但若表示教育阶段便存在顺序，应先说明变量的实际含义。
studyNotes.simpleEn: Nominal categories have no natural order. Ordinal categories are ordered but gaps may differ. Binary data have two categories.
examFocus: 三种类别定义及例子
有序不等于等距
识别类别数字编码
studyNotes.pitfall: 原课件school type例子有歧义：教育阶段通常有序。答题用insurance type作为清晰的名义例子。

studyNotes.title: Mixed methods
studyNotes.explanationZh: 混合方法结合数量与意义：定量回答多少、频率、哪些群体；定性解释为什么、怎样和经历。疫苗记录可以显示某区接种率低，访谈再查交通、工作冲突、担忧或不信任。
studyNotes.simpleEn: Use numbers to find the pattern and interviews to understand the reasons.
examFocus: 定量与定性各回答什么
设计能互补的两种数据
studyNotes.pitfall: 一份含数字和文字的表格本身，不足以证明已进行严谨的混合方法研究。

studyNotes.title: Electronic health record (EHR)
studyNotes.explanationZh: EHR是随时间累积的电子健康记录，跨多次照护接触，供获授权者使用，兼有临床与行政数据。可包括诊断、药物、过敏、备注、检验、生命体征、影像与收费资料；首先用于照护，研究及公共卫生常是二次用途。
studyNotes.simpleEn: An EHR is a digital health record built over time and used by authorised users across care encounters.
examFocus: 纵向、授权、多次接触
临床与行政数据例子
主要与二次用途
studyNotes.pitfall: EHR并非为研究问题专门采集，因此不能假设所有字段都完整、一致。
studyNotes.visualExplanation: 配图展示电子健康记录的应用场景；定义与资料种类见幻灯片及讲者备注。

studyNotes.title: EMR, EHR and PHR
studyNotes.explanationZh: EMR通常围绕一个诊所或机构；EHR概念上支持不同照护场所的信息分享；PHR面向患者查阅和使用。现实中EMR/EHR用词可能混用，要根据本地使用、跨机构共享、患者使用三个重点解释。
studyNotes.simpleEn: EMR usually serves one organisation. EHR supports sharing across settings. PHR is designed for patient use.
examFocus: 三者概念比较
现实用词并非绝对界线
studyNotes.pitfall: 原幻灯片写HER属于拼写错误，本资料统一为EHR。

studyNotes.title: Triage
studyNotes.explanationZh: 分诊是快速评估病人，按严重程度与紧急性安排优先次序。它并非单纯先到先看；课件例子中，呼吸困难患者通常比轻微割伤者更急。
studyNotes.simpleEn: Triage gives priority according to urgency and severity, rather than arrival time alone.
examFocus: 定义分诊
用情境说明为何优先处理
studyNotes.pitfall: 本课题只考概念，不从简单案例推导完整临床分诊级别。

studyNotes.title: Strengths and limits of EHR data
studyNotes.explanationZh: EHR通常较及时，可追踪患者、协作照护、质量改进及公共卫生报告。它反映在该系统中曾求诊、获得照护、被记录且能取得的数据，不能自然代表全社区，尤其可能漏掉不就医或到别处就医的人。
studyNotes.simpleEn: EHR data can support timely follow-up and quality improvement, but may miss people outside the care system.
examFocus: 列出EHR用途
解释覆盖限制与代表性
studyNotes.pitfall: 记录很多也不能证明总体覆盖完整。

studyNotes.title: Population → frame → sample → respondents
studyNotes.explanationZh: 目标总体是想了解的人；抽样框是用来接触人的名单或方法；样本是被选中的人；应答者是真正参与的人。只通过患者门户调查全县成年人，会漏掉没有门户权限的人，属于覆盖偏差风险。
studyNotes.simpleEn: The population is the target group. The frame reaches people. The sample is selected. Respondents actually take part.
examFocus: 四个概念顺序与区别
从患者门户案例找覆盖偏差
studyNotes.pitfall: 样本不等于应答者；抽样框不全时，增加回复量也未必消除偏差。

studyNotes.title: Better survey questions
studyNotes.explanationZh: 好问题应清晰、具体、中立、只问一个概念、有时间界限、用容易理解的语言。“你多久运动和健康饮食一次”同时问两件事，应拆开；“经常”需要界定。
studyNotes.simpleEn: Ask one clear, neutral and time-bounded question at a time.
examFocus: 找双重问题、引导问题、含糊时间
能改写调查题目
studyNotes.pitfall: 不能用一个答案同时准确表示运动频率和饮食习惯。

studyNotes.title: Survey strengths and bias
studyNotes.explanationZh: 问卷可快速、高效、匿名，便于用相同问题比较多人；但有不应答、回忆、社会期许和误解题目等问题。要问“谁没有回答”，不能只数有多少人回答。
studyNotes.simpleEn: Surveys are efficient and comparable, but nonresponse and self-report bias can affect the results.
examFocus: 四种问卷限制
区分不应答与回忆/社会期许
大样本不必然代表总体
studyNotes.pitfall: 匿名可减轻某些顾虑，却不能保证消除所有偏差。

studyNotes.title: Triangulation
studyNotes.explanationZh: 三角互证是结合不同来源增强解释：EHR看已记录病况与服务；问卷看体验和障碍；生命登记看出生死亡；社区资料看住房交通环境；访谈看意义。低筛查记录与交通困难访谈结合，可更好支持行动，但并非自动证明因果。
studyNotes.simpleEn: Triangulation combines different sources to build a stronger interpretation.
examFocus: 选择互补资料来源
说明资料之间如何支持或质疑同一解释
studyNotes.pitfall: 多个来源若共享同一种遗漏，仍可能一起出错。

studyNotes.title: Reminder attendance mini-case
studyNotes.explanationZh: 收到短信者出席率65%，未收到者50%，观察差是15个百分点。但两组可能在手机稳定性、交通、经济障碍上不同，不能据此断定提醒造成改善。随机推行、公平对照及考虑重要差异能提供更好证据。
studyNotes.simpleEn: Attendance was 15 percentage points higher in the reminder group, but group differences may explain part of the gap.
examFocus: 关联不等于已证实因果
混杂因素与更公平比较
studyNotes.pitfall: 15个百分点不等于相对增加15%；也不要把比较结果直接写成因果结论。

studyNotes.title: Section 4: ethics and governance
studyNotes.explanationZh: 这是“Ethics, HIPAA, GDPR, and Governance”的章节分隔页，没有额外正文或讲者备注。复习按范围中的63–65、74–76和80页掌握法律、伦理、GDPR与治理；不能因标题有HIPAA便把所有不在范围内的HIPAA页自动加入。
studyNotes.simpleEn: This divider introduces ethics and governance. Revise the specific slides listed in the Test 1 scope.
examFocus: 识别章节结构与范围
studyNotes.pitfall: 该页没有提供HIPAA细节，不能凭标题补造考试内容。

studyNotes.title: Law, policy and ethics
studyNotes.explanationZh: 法律规定必须满足的最低标准；政策是机构自己的规则和程序；伦理关注公平、权利、伤害、信任和问责。要同时问“可不可以做”和“应不应该做”；合法的数据用途仍可能污名化社区或分配不公。
studyNotes.simpleEn: Law sets required standards. Policy gives organisational rules. Ethics asks whether a practice is fair and responsible.
examFocus: 三者定义
说明合法不自动等于伦理妥当
studyNotes.pitfall: 不能用“符合法律”替代对公平、信任和伤害的讨论。

studyNotes.title: Privacy, confidentiality and security
studyNotes.explanationZh: 隐私涉及个人对资料收集及分享的控制与期待；保密是受托者不随意披露资料的责任；安全是阻止未授权访问、遗失的措施，如密码、加密、权限、实体保护及日志。三个概念相关但层次不同。
studyNotes.simpleEn: Privacy concerns control and expectations. Confidentiality is a duty to protect entrusted information. Security provides safeguards.
examFocus: 三个概念各配一个例子
技术安全不能单独解决全部伦理问题
studyNotes.pitfall: 只写加密并未回答是否应收集或分享资料。

studyNotes.title: Belmont principles
studyNotes.explanationZh: 尊重个人：自主及知情选择；行善：增加利益、减少伤害；公正：公平分配负担与利益。应用时问谁能选择、谁受益、谁担风险、谁被排除。原图三环分别是Respect for Persons、Beneficence、Justice。
studyNotes.simpleEn: Respect choice, reduce harm and share benefits and burdens fairly.
examFocus: 三个正式名称与含义
把案例问题对应原则
studyNotes.pitfall: 行善与公正可能同时相关，按案例说明理由比只写一个名称更完整。
studyNotes.visualExplanation: 三环图是Belmont三原则，不是GDPR七原则；图内各环名称必须分别记住。

studyNotes.title: Seven GDPR principles (image)
studyNotes.explanationZh: 图片含完整七原则：合法、公平、透明；目的限制；数据最小化；准确性；储存期限限制；完整性与保密性；问责。图意分别是清楚合法地处理、按特定目的使用、只收必要数据、保持正确及时、不超期保存、以安全措施保护、承担并记录合规责任。
studyNotes.simpleEn: GDPR principles cover fair and clear use, a defined purpose, necessary data, accuracy, limited storage, protection and accountability.
examFocus: 逐一列出七原则
从收集过量/长期保存/错误资料/缺少记录等场景判原则
studyNotes.pitfall: 这页是纯图片，不能因没有可提取文字而跳过；最后一个accountability不是accessibility。
studyNotes.visualExplanation: 上排四项：Lawfulness, fairness and transparency；Purpose limitation；Data minimization；Accuracy。下排三项：Storage limitation；Integrity and confidentiality；Accountability。

studyNotes.title: GDPR high-level framework
studyNotes.explanationZh: 课件把GDPR介绍为个人资料保护框架，健康数据属于敏感类别。处理个人资料需有合法依据，处理特殊类别资料另有条件。它比HIPAA范围和结构不同；适用性要按人员、机构活动、数据及地点等具体情况判断。
studyNotes.simpleEn: GDPR protects personal data. Health data need a lawful basis and additional conditions for special-category data.
examFocus: 一般合法依据与特殊类别条件
不能简单称为European HIPAA
studyNotes.pitfall: 不要把“任何健康数据一律需要某一种同意”或“所有场景都同样适用”当作本课结论。

studyNotes.title: GDPR individual rights
studyNotes.explanationZh: 个人权利可能包括知情和访问、更正、特定情况下删除、限制或反对处理、数据可携带，以及关于仅由自动化决定的保障。老师备注强调这些权利不是绝对的，要看背景和法律依据。
studyNotes.simpleEn: People may access and correct data and have other rights, but the details depend on context and legal basis.
examFocus: 列举权利
知道删除等权利有适用条件
透明与组织责任
studyNotes.pitfall: “要求删除就必须无条件删除”不是课件立场。

studyNotes.title: Data governance
studyNotes.explanationZh: 治理规定目的与允许用途、数据所有者和管理者、权限与审计、共享与保留、质量复核和事件应对。治理需要领导、临床、公共卫生、法律隐私团队、社区代表、分析人员和受影响者共同参与，并非只有IT部门的任务。
studyNotes.simpleEn: Data governance defines who may use data, for what purpose, under which rules and with what oversight.
examFocus: 五类治理内容
参与者及职责
治理与单纯技术安全的区别
studyNotes.pitfall: “装了安全软件”不足以证明已经建立数据治理。

studyNotes.title: Prevalence
studyNotes.explanationZh: 现患率表示在某时间点或期间已有该病的人有多少。简单时点现患率＝该时点已有病例数÷同一时点总体人数，乘100%可写成百分比。它反映当前负担，支持人员、药物和长期服务规划；病程长时可出现新发少而现患多。
studyNotes.simpleEn: Point prevalence is existing cases divided by the population at that time. It describes the current burden.
examFocus: 分子已有病例，分母同期总体
百分比计算与解释
现患负担与服务规划
studyNotes.pitfall: 不能把分子只换成新病例，或把分子分母取自不同时间/人群。

studyNotes.title: Fair comparison between groups
studyNotes.explanationZh: 公平比较应保持病例定义、时间、资料来源、分母逻辑一致，并考虑有关亚组。原始病例数受人口规模影响；100例的大县可能比20例的小县有更低比例。
studyNotes.simpleEn: Compare the same definitions and time periods, and use suitable denominators. Counts alone can mislead.
examFocus: 比较前检查四项一致性
用比例而非只看总数
相关亚组差异
studyNotes.pitfall: 率或比例更合理，但若定义与时间不同，单靠除人口仍不足以公平比较。

studyNotes.title: Section 6: clinical workflows and informatics
studyNotes.explanationZh: 这是“Clinical Workflows, Delivery Models, and Health Informatics”的分隔页，没有额外正文或讲者备注。范围内96和100页考数据如何在工作流程中产生、哪些角色产生哪些资料。
studyNotes.simpleEn: This divider introduces workflows and informatics. Focus on how people and processes create health data.
examFocus: 用章节结构连接96与100页
studyNotes.pitfall: 不要把章节标题当成已经讲解了所有医疗服务模式。

studyNotes.title: Data within a system
studyNotes.explanationZh: 数据由工作流程产生，流程跨不同场所；健康信息学连接人、流程与技术。字段缺失、结果延迟或重复记录可能来自流程设计，所以应调查系统原因，而不只责备个人。
studyNotes.simpleEn: Health informatics connects people, processes and technology. Data problems may come from the way work is organised.
examFocus: 人、流程、技术三者关系
分析缺失、延迟、重复的流程原因
studyNotes.pitfall: 只培训某个员工，可能无法修复系统接口或流程中的根本问题。

studyNotes.title: Where health data are created
studyNotes.explanationZh: 登记产生人口、保险和联系方式；护理产生生命体征和筛查；临床人员产生病程、诊断与计划；检验/药房产生结果与用药；收费产生代码与索赔；患者产生门户留言和自报结局。同一患者跨系统有多种资料视角，处方、配药和实际服药并不等同。
studyNotes.simpleEn: Registration, nurses, clinicians, laboratories, pharmacies, billing teams and patients create different parts of the record.
examFocus: 角色与数据匹配
处方、配药、自报服药的含义差别
studyNotes.pitfall: 药物在处方清单中不保证患者已取药或实际服用。

questions.promptEn: Which statement is knowledge in the missed-appointment example?
questions.promptZh: 爽约案例中哪一句属于知识/解释？
questions.answerEn: Transport may be a barrier.
questions.answerZh: 交通可能构成障碍。
questions.explanationZh: A是数据，B是加入背景的信息，C是解释，D是行动；解释仍需证据支持。
options: Missed appointments increased in one neighbourhood.

questions.promptEn: Which is health data beyond clinical care?
questions.promptZh: 哪项属于临床照护以外的健康数据？
questions.answerEn: Housing conditions.
questions.answerZh: 住房条件。
questions.explanationZh: 住房、交通与环境都可能影响健康结果。

questions.promptEn: A table has one row for each clinic visit. What is its unit of analysis?
questions.promptZh: 每行是一趟门诊就诊，分析单位是什么？
questions.answerEn: A clinic visit.
questions.answerZh: 一次就诊。
questions.explanationZh: 同一人可以有多行，因此行数不等于患者人数。
options: A person, regardless of repeat visits

questions.promptEn: Which numeric field is normally a label rather than a quantity?
questions.promptZh: 哪个数字字段通常是标签而非数量？
questions.answerEn: Patient ID.
questions.answerZh: 患者编号。
questions.explanationZh: 编号中的数字用于识别，不能按数值大小解释健康程度。

questions.promptEn: Which variable is continuous even if recorded as a whole number?
questions.promptZh: 即使记录为整数，哪个变量的本质仍是连续的？
questions.answerEn: Weight rounded to the nearest kilogram.
questions.answerZh: 四舍五入到公斤的体重。
questions.explanationZh: 四舍五入改变记录精度，未把原本的测量变成计数。
rubric: 四舍五入到公斤的体重。
options: Weight rounded to the nearest kilogram

questions.promptEn: Which practice improves the rigour of interview analysis?
questions.promptZh: 哪种方法可提升访谈分析的严谨性？
questions.answerEn: Use a clear coding framework and review themes.
questions.answerZh: 使用清楚的编码框架并复核主题。
questions.explanationZh: 讲者备注列出编码、主题、多位复核者及过程记录。
rubric: 使用清楚的编码框架并复核主题。
options: Use a clear coding framework and review themes.
Select only quotes that support the conclusion.
Avoid recording how themes were chosen.
Assume written responses need no analysis.

questions.promptEn: Poor, fair, good and excellent describe which data type?
questions.promptZh: poor、fair、good、excellent属于哪种数据？
questions.answerEn: Ordinal.
questions.answerZh: 有序类别。
questions.explanationZh: 存在等级顺序，但相邻等级间距不保证相等。

questions.promptEn: Which is the clearest mixed-methods plan?
questions.promptZh: 哪项最清楚体现混合方法？
questions.answerEn: Count uptake and interview residents about barriers.
questions.answerZh: 统计接种情况，同时访谈居民的障碍。
questions.explanationZh: 数量告诉我们模式，访谈补充原因和体验。
rubric: 统计接种情况，同时访谈居民的障碍。
options: Count uptake and interview residents about barriers.
Replace all interview answers with random numbers.

questions.promptEn: Which feature best describes an EHR?
questions.promptZh: 哪项最能描述EHR？
questions.answerEn: A digital record built over time for authorised use.
questions.answerZh: 供获授权使用、随时间累积的电子记录。
questions.explanationZh: EHR兼含临床与行政数据，通常跨多次照护接触。
rubric: 供获授权使用、随时间累积的电子记录。
options: A record that is deleted after every visit
A digital record built over time for authorised use
A public list of every resident

questions.promptEn: Which record is designed for patient access and use?
questions.promptZh: 哪种记录主要为患者访问与使用而设计？
questions.answerEn: PHR (personal health record).
questions.answerZh: PHR，个人健康记录。
questions.explanationZh: EMR通常围绕一个机构，EHR强调跨场所共享，PHR面向患者。

questions.promptEn: What is the main basis of triage?
questions.promptZh: 分诊优先次序主要依据什么？
questions.answerEn: Urgency and severity.
questions.answerZh: 病情的紧急性与严重程度。
questions.explanationZh: 课件用呼吸困难与轻微割伤说明先到不一定先处理。
rubric: 病情的紧急性与严重程度。

questions.promptEn: Why may one hospital EHR fail to represent the whole community?
questions.promptZh: 为何单家医院EHR不能自动代表全社区？
questions.answerEn: People who do not use that system may be missing.
questions.answerZh: 未使用该系统的人可能未被记录。
questions.explanationZh: EHR首先反映已寻求、获得、记录且可取得的照护。
rubric: 未使用该系统的人可能未被记录。
options: People who do not use that system may be missing.

questions.promptEn: Who are respondents in a survey?
questions.promptZh: 问卷中的respondents指谁？
questions.answerEn: People who actually participate.
questions.answerZh: 实际参与回答的人。
questions.explanationZh: 目标总体、抽样框、样本和应答者是不同层次。
options: Only people selected who never reply

questions.promptEn: What is the main problem with “How often do you exercise and eat healthy food?”
questions.promptZh: “你多久运动和健康饮食一次”主要有什么问题？
questions.answerEn: It asks two different things in one question.
questions.answerZh: 一个问题问了两件不同事情。
questions.explanationZh: 运动频率与饮食习惯可不同，应拆成独立题目。
rubric: 一个问题问了两件不同事情。
options: It asks two different things in one question.
It offers too many data sources.

questions.promptEn: People forget how often they visited a clinic last year. Which bias is most direct?
questions.promptZh: 受访者记不起去年就诊次数，最直接是哪种偏差？
questions.answerEn: Recall bias.
questions.answerZh: 回忆偏差。
questions.explanationZh: 无法准确记起过去事件影响自报答案。

questions.promptEn: Which example shows triangulation?
questions.promptZh: 哪个案例体现三角互证？
questions.answerEn: Combine EHR screening records with interviews about transport barriers.
questions.answerZh: 结合筛查记录与交通障碍访谈。
questions.explanationZh: 不同来源贡献不同信息，有助形成更强解释。
rubric: 结合筛查记录与交通障碍访谈。
options: Use one EHR count as proof of every explanation.
Combine EHR screening records with interviews about transport barriers.
Increase font size in a report.

questions.promptEn: Attendance is 65% with reminders and 50% without. What is the observed absolute difference?
questions.promptZh: 提醒组65%、未提醒组50%，观察到的绝对差是多少？
questions.answerEn: 15 percentage points.
questions.answerZh: 15个百分点。
questions.explanationZh: 65%−50%=15个百分点；此差异本身不能证明因果。

questions.promptEn: Which principle asks for a fair distribution of benefits and burdens?
questions.promptZh: 哪项Belmont原则强调公平分配利益与负担？
questions.answerEn: Justice.
questions.answerZh: 公正。
questions.explanationZh: 尊重个人关注自主，行善关注益处与伤害，公正关注分配。

questions.promptEn: Distinguish law, policy and ethics in one sentence each.
questions.promptZh: 分别用一句话区分法律、政策和伦理。
questions.answerEn: Law sets required minimum standards. Policy gives an organisation’s rules. Ethics considers fairness, rights, harm, trust and accountability.
questions.answerZh: 法律规定必须达到的最低标准；政策规定机构规则和流程；伦理考虑公平、权利、伤害、信任与问责。
questions.explanationZh: 三者作用不同；符合法律仍需考虑伦理后果。
rubric: 政策：机构规则与程序（1分）
伦理：公平/权利/伤害等（1分）

questions.promptEn: Define privacy, confidentiality and security. Give one example for each.
questions.promptZh: 定义隐私、保密和安全，并各举一例。
questions.answerEn: Privacy concerns a person’s control and expectations, such as choices about sharing. Confidentiality is a duty not to disclose entrusted information. Security uses safeguards such as access control. For confidentiality, a nurse does not share a patient record with an unauthorised friend.
questions.answerZh: 隐私：个人对资料收集分享的控制与期待，如分享选择；保密：受托者不泄露资料的责任；安全：用权限、加密等防护。 保密性的例子：护士不向未获授权的朋友透露患者病历。
questions.explanationZh: 答案应同时说明概念与对应行为，不能把三个词全部写成密码保护。
rubric: 隐私定义及适当例子（2分）
保密定义及适当例子（2分）
安全定义及适当例子（2分）

questions.promptEn: Name all seven GDPR principles shown in the image.
questions.promptZh: 列出图片中的GDPR七原则。
questions.answerEn: Lawfulness, fairness and transparency; purpose limitation; data minimisation; accuracy; storage limitation; integrity and confidentiality; accountability.
questions.answerZh: 合法、公平、透明；目的限制；数据最小化；准确性；储存期限限制；完整性与保密性；问责。
questions.explanationZh: 第一项含三个词但合为一项；图片共有七项。
rubric: 七项原则各1分；首项三个词作为一个原则

questions.promptEn: State four GDPR individual rights from the lecture and one qualification.
questions.promptZh: 列出课件中的四项GDPR个人权利，并写出一个限制说明。
questions.answerEn: Examples are access, correction, erasure in certain circumstances and data portability. These rights are not absolute and depend on context and legal basis.
questions.answerZh: 例如访问、更正、在特定情况下删除、数据可携带。权利不是绝对的，适用细节取决于情境及法律依据。
questions.explanationZh: 也接受知情、限制/反对处理及仅由自动化决定的保障等课件例子。
rubric: 说明有情境/法律依据限制（1分）

questions.promptEn: Write the point-prevalence formula and explain what it measures.
questions.promptZh: 写出时点现患率公式并说明含义。
questions.answerEn: Point prevalence = existing cases ÷ population at that time. It measures the current disease burden.
questions.answerZh: 时点现患率＝该时点已有病例数÷该时点总体人数，反映当前患病负担。
questions.explanationZh: 若以百分比表示，再乘100%；分子分母应是同一时间同一人群。

questions.promptEn: Match each source to a data example: registration, nursing and billing.
questions.promptZh: 分别为登记、护理、收费各举一个数据例子。
questions.answerEn: Registration: contact or insurance details. Nursing: vital signs or screening results. Billing: codes or claims.
questions.answerZh: 登记：联系方式或保险；护理：生命体征或筛查结果；收费：代码或索赔。
questions.explanationZh: 不同工作岗位在流程中产生不同记录。

questions.promptEn: A clinic records 120 missed appointments, notices a rise in one area, suspects transport problems and offers evening appointments. Classify the four stages and state what evidence is still needed.
questions.promptZh: 诊所记录120次爽约，发现某区上升，怀疑交通问题，增设晚间门诊。分类四阶段，并说明还需什么证据。
questions.answerEn: The count is data. The local increase is information. The transport explanation is knowledge or interpretation. Offering appointments is action. Interviews or transport data are needed to test the explanation.
questions.answerZh: 120次是数据；某区增加是信息；交通障碍是知识/解释；增设服务是行动。应收集访谈、交通或相关障碍资料检验解释。
questions.explanationZh: 行动可基于合理解释，但不能把解释本身当成已证实的原因。
rubric: 指出交通原因未证实（1分）

questions.promptEn: Hospital records show no increase in asthma, but residents report worsening air pollution and difficulty getting appointments. Explain why more health data are needed and propose two sources.
questions.promptZh: 医院记录未见哮喘增加，但居民表示污染加剧且难预约。为何需更多健康数据？提出两个来源。
questions.answerEn: Hospital records may miss people who cannot reach care. Environmental data can describe pollution, and a community survey or interviews can describe symptoms and access barriers. Together they give a fuller picture.
questions.answerZh: 医院记录可能漏掉无法就诊者。环境监测可反映污染；社区问卷或访谈可了解症状与服务障碍，补全临床资料。
questions.explanationZh: 这是“健康数据超越病历”与EHR覆盖限制的结合，不应直接断定污染已造成新增病例。
rubric: 避免无证据因果结论（1分）

questions.promptEn: An analyst finds that a neighbourhood has low income and high missed-appointment rates, then writes “Every low-income resident misses appointments.” Identify the error and give a better conclusion.
questions.promptZh: 某社区收入低、爽约率高，分析员写“每位低收入居民都会爽约”。指出错误并改写结论。
questions.answerEn: The data describe a neighbourhood, not every person. A better conclusion is: this neighbourhood has a high missed-appointment rate; individual data are needed to study which residents miss visits and why.
questions.answerZh: 错误在于把社区层面的关系套到每个人。可写：该社区爽约率较高；需个人层面资料判断谁爽约及相关原因。
questions.explanationZh: 单位必须与问题一致。群体关系不能自动证明个人关系，更不能推出“每个人”。
rubric: 指出群体到个人的不当推论（1分）

questions.promptEn: A file has 200 visit rows from 80 unique patients. (a) What does one row represent? (b) What is the average number of recorded visits per patient? (c) Can you report 200 patients?
questions.promptZh: 文件有200行就诊、80个唯一患者。(a)每行代表什么？(b)每位患者平均记录多少次就诊？(c)能报告200名患者吗？
questions.answerEn: (a) One clinic visit. (b) 200 ÷ 80 = 2.5 recorded visits per patient. (c) No; there are 80 unique patients.
questions.answerZh: (a)一次就诊；(b)200÷80＝2.5次/人；(c)不能，唯一患者数是80。
questions.explanationZh: 单个人的次数为整数，但群体平均次数可以是小数。

questions.promptEn: Classify patient ID, admission count, temperature rounded to whole °C, insurance type and satisfaction rated poor/fair/good/excellent. Explain two common mistakes.
questions.promptZh: 分类：患者编号、住院次数、取整的摄氏体温、保险类型、poor/fair/good/excellent满意度，并解释两个常见错误。
questions.answerEn: Patient ID is a nominal label; admission count is discrete quantitative; temperature is continuous quantitative despite rounding; insurance type is nominal; satisfaction is ordinal. Do not average IDs or assume equal gaps between satisfaction levels.
questions.answerZh: 编号为名义标签；住院次数是离散定量；取整体温仍来自连续测量；保险类型是名义类别；满意度是有序类别。编号不可作数量平均，有序等级间距不一定相等。
questions.explanationZh: 分类依据变量意义，而不是数字外观或小数位数。
rubric: 数字标签不等于数量（1分）
有序等级不保证等距（1分）

questions.promptEn: A team scores interview themes as 1 = transport, 2 = fear and 3 = work conflict, then reports a mean barrier score of 2.1. Evaluate this analysis and suggest a useful summary.
questions.promptZh: 团队把访谈主题编码1交通、2恐惧、3工作冲突，报告平均障碍分2.1。评价并提出有意义的总结。
questions.answerEn: These numbers label themes; they do not measure amounts. A mean of 2.1 has no clear meaning. Report theme counts or percentages and use quotations and a clear coding process to explain the experiences.
questions.answerZh: 数字是主题标签，不是数量，平均2.1没有清晰含义。可报告各主题人数/比例，结合访谈例句及透明编码过程解释经历。
questions.explanationZh: 编码有助整理定性资料，但不能凭数字编码制造等距数量尺度。
rubric: 说明平均值无清楚意义（1分）

questions.promptEn: Vaccination uptake is lower in District A. Design a small mixed-methods study with a quantitative question, a qualitative question and a way to combine the findings.
questions.promptZh: A区接种率较低。设计小型混合方法研究：定量问题、定性问题及整合结果的方法。
questions.answerEn: Quantitative: what is uptake in each district during the same period? Qualitative: what barriers do residents describe? Compare uptake with interview themes to decide whether access support or clearer information may help.
questions.answerZh: 定量：同一期间各区接种率多少？定性：居民遇到什么障碍？把率的模式与访谈主题对应，判断交通支持或信息改善是否值得尝试。
questions.explanationZh: 定量显示差异，定性解释可能原因；干预选择要保留证据不确定性。

questions.promptEn: A clinic says its EMR shares information with all hospitals because “EMR and EHR always mean the same thing.” Evaluate the claim and state what to check.
questions.promptZh: 诊所声称“EMR和EHR永远相同”，所以本机构EMR必能与全部医院共享资料。评价并说明应检查什么。
questions.answerEn: The terms can overlap in practice, but the name alone does not prove sharing. Check the actual settings covered, authorised users, information-exchange functions and patient access. Conceptually EMR is often local, EHR supports sharing, and PHR serves patient use.
questions.answerZh: 现实中名词会混用，但名称不保证实际共享能力。检查覆盖场所、授权用户、交换功能及患者使用。概念上EMR较本地、EHR强调共享、PHR面向患者。
questions.explanationZh: 老师要求理解概念而非绝对定义；也不能由概念推定任何系统已经互通。
rubric: 名称不足以证明共享（1分）

questions.promptEn: A patient with a minor cut arrived first. Another arrives later with breathing difficulty. Explain the triage principle without assigning a detailed clinical category.
questions.promptZh: 轻微割伤患者先到，呼吸困难患者后到。说明分诊原则，无需指定临床分级。
questions.answerEn: Triage prioritises urgency and severity. The patient with breathing difficulty would usually receive attention first because the condition may be more urgent. Arrival time alone does not determine priority.
questions.answerZh: 分诊按紧急性和严重程度决定优先。呼吸困难通常更急，应先处理；不能只按到达时间。
questions.explanationZh: 题目考课件提供的原则与例子，不要求诊断或完整分诊标准。
rubric: 说明先到并非唯一依据（1分）

questions.promptEn: A manager uses the hospital EHR to estimate unmet healthcare needs for all residents. Give two EHR strengths, two limits and one complementary source.
questions.promptZh: 经理想用医院EHR估计全体居民未满足的医疗需求。列两项优势、两项限制及一个补充来源。
questions.answerEn: EHRs can be timely and follow patients over time. They may miss people outside the system and care or needs that were not documented. A community survey can reach experiences and barriers beyond recorded care.
questions.answerZh: 优势：较及时、可纵向追踪；限制：漏掉系统外居民，未记录的照护/需求可能缺失；补充社区问卷，了解体验和服务障碍。
questions.explanationZh: EHR适合描述记录中的照护，但未满足需求尤其可能发生在没有接触系统的人。

questions.promptEn: A county has 10,000 adults. Only 6,000 portal users can be contacted; 1,000 are selected and 400 reply. Identify population, frame, sample and respondents. Calculate the response proportion among those selected and identify the coverage problem.
questions.promptZh: 全县10000名成人；只能联系6000名门户用户，抽1000名，400名回复。辨认四层概念，算入选者回复比例并指出覆盖问题。
questions.answerEn: Population: 10,000 adults. Frame: 6,000 portal users. Sample: 1,000 selected people. Respondents: 400 replies. Response proportion = 400 ÷ 1,000 = 40%. Adults without portal access are not covered by the frame.
questions.answerZh: 总体10000；抽样框6000门户用户；样本1000；应答者400。回复比例＝400÷1000＝40%。非门户用户没有被覆盖。
questions.explanationZh: 40%是入选者中的回复比例，不是全县参与比例；覆盖偏差与不应答是两个问题。
rubric: 识别非门户用户被排除（1分）

questions.promptEn: Rewrite this survey item: “Do you regularly exercise and follow the excellent advice of our clinic?” Explain three changes.
questions.promptZh: 改写：“你是否经常运动并遵守我们诊所的优秀建议？”解释三项修改。
questions.answerEn: Use separate neutral questions, such as “In the past 7 days, on how many days did you exercise?” and “In the past 7 days, how often did you follow the clinic’s advice?” Define the advice clearly for the actual study. Remove “excellent”, separate the ideas and use a clear time period.
questions.answerZh: 拆成中立问题，例如“过去7天有几天运动？”和“过去7天你多久按诊所建议执行一次？”实际研究要说明具体建议。删除“优秀”，分开概念，明确时间。
questions.explanationZh: 可接受其他清晰中立的改写；不同健康建议应按具体行为分别询问。
rubric: 说明需界定具体建议/行为（1分）

questions.promptEn: An anonymous online survey has 5,000 replies, mostly from young portal users. The report says the sample must represent all older residents because the response count is large. Evaluate the claim and suggest two improvements.
questions.promptZh: 匿名网上问卷有5000回复，多为年轻门户用户。报告认为回复量大，所以必代表所有长者。评价并提两项改善。
questions.answerEn: A large count does not ensure representation. Older people without portal access may be missed, and some selected people may not reply. Use additional contact methods such as phone or in-person surveys and compare respondents with the target population.
questions.answerZh: 大样本不保证代表性；无门户的长者可能未被覆盖，入选者也可能不回复。可增加电话/面对面渠道，并比较应答者与目标总体特征。
questions.explanationZh: 匿名能降低某些社会期许顾虑，但不会自动解决覆盖与不应答问题。
rubric: 否定大样本自动代表（1分）
检查总体与应答者差异（1分）

questions.promptEn: A clinic observes low screening attendance. Choose three complementary data sources and state what each can add. Also state one limit of combining them.
questions.promptZh: 诊所发现筛查出席率低。选三种互补来源并说明各自贡献，再指出整合的一项限制。
questions.answerEn: EHRs show documented screening. Surveys describe patient experiences and barriers. Transport or community data describe local access. Together they support interpretation, but agreement alone does not prove the cause and shared coverage gaps may remain.
questions.answerZh: EHR显示已记录筛查；问卷说明体验及障碍；交通/社区资料描述可达性。结合能增强解释，但一致仍不自动证明原因，也可能有共同遗漏。
questions.explanationZh: 选择其他合理组合亦可，如访谈代问卷；关键是解释互补作用与证据限制。

questions.promptEn: Reminders are received mainly by patients with stable phones and transport. Attendance is 65% versus 50%. Write a cautious conclusion, name two alternative explanations and propose a stronger comparison.
questions.promptZh: 提醒主要发给手机稳定、交通可靠者，出席率65%对50%。写审慎结论、两种其他解释及更强比较方案。
questions.answerEn: The reminder group had attendance 15 percentage points higher, but the data do not establish causation. Stable phone access and transport may explain differences. A randomised rollout with fair outcome measurement would provide stronger evidence.
questions.answerZh: 提醒组高15个百分点，但数据未建立因果。手机可用性和交通条件可能造成组间差异。随机推行、统一测量结果可提供更强证据。
questions.explanationZh: 也接受公平对照并考虑重要差异的分析；关键是避免把观察差全归给短信。

questions.promptEn: An organisation says a data project is acceptable because it is legal. The project labels a neighbourhood as “unhealthy”, excludes residents from decisions and gives them no benefit. Discuss law, ethics and Belmont principles.
questions.promptZh: 机构认为项目合法就可以做，但把社区标成“不健康”，排除居民参与，也不让其受益。结合法律、伦理与Belmont原则讨论。
questions.answerEn: Legal compliance alone does not settle fairness or harm. Excluding residents affects respect for persons and trust. Stigma may create harm, raising beneficence concerns. Unequal burdens and no local benefit raise justice concerns. Involve residents and review risks and benefits.
questions.answerZh: 合法不解决公平及伤害问题。排除居民损害尊重个人和信任；污名风险涉及行善；负担不公平且无社区利益涉及公正。应让居民参与并复核风险与利益。
questions.explanationZh: 多个原则可同时适用，答案应把具体事实与原则联系，而非只背名称。

questions.promptEn: A database is encrypted, but a staff member with authorised access sends identifiable records to a friend for curiosity. Explain the privacy, confidentiality and security issues.
questions.promptZh: 数据库已加密，但有权限的职员出于好奇把可识别记录发给朋友。解释隐私、保密与安全问题。
questions.answerEn: Encryption is one security safeguard, but it does not make every disclosure appropriate. Sharing without a proper purpose conflicts with privacy expectations and breaches the duty of confidentiality. Access rules, audit logs and staff procedures are also needed.
questions.answerZh: 加密只是安全措施，不能让任何披露都合理。无正当目的分享违背隐私期待及保密责任；还需权限规则、审计日志和员工程序。
questions.explanationZh: 获授权查看不等于获授权随意对外披露。
rubric: 承认加密的安全作用（1分）
查看与披露权限区分（1分）

questions.promptEn: A survey needs age group and clinic attendance. The team also collects full addresses and ID numbers “in case they are useful”, keeps everything forever and never checks errors. Map three problems to the GDPR principles shown in the lecture.
questions.promptZh: 问卷只需年龄组和出席情况，却额外收完整住址和证件号“以后可能有用”，永久保存且从不查错。对应课件GDPR原则指出三个问题。
questions.answerEn: Unnecessary addresses and IDs conflict with data minimisation. Keeping all records forever conflicts with storage limitation. Never checking errors conflicts with accuracy. Define the purpose, collect only necessary fields, set retention rules and review data quality.
questions.answerZh: 不必要地址与证件号涉及数据最小化；永久保存涉及储存期限限制；不查错涉及准确性。应明确目的、只收所需字段、设置保留规则并复核质量。
questions.explanationZh: 以课程原则分析，不需要对真实项目做完整法律裁定。
rubric: 三个正确原则对应各1分

questions.promptEn: After explaining seven GDPR principles, a team says it has finished compliance because it can name them. Explain the role of accountability and suggest evidence of responsible governance.
questions.promptZh: 团队能背GDPR七原则，就认为已经完成合规。说明问责的作用，并提可显示负责任治理的证据。
questions.answerEn: Naming principles is not enough. Accountability means taking responsibility and documenting efforts. Useful evidence includes assigned data owners or stewards, access and audit records, sharing and retention rules, quality reviews and incident-response procedures.
questions.answerZh: 背名称不足够。问责要求承担责任并记录落实过程。证据可包括所有者/管理者职责、访问审计记录、共享保留规则、质量复核及事件应对流程。
questions.explanationZh: 该图将accountability解释为负责和记录合规努力，治理页给出落实机制。
rubric: 四项有效治理证据各1分

questions.promptEn: A patient asks for access, correction of an error and deletion of all records. A colleague says GDPR guarantees immediate deletion in every situation. Write a balanced course-based reply.
questions.promptZh: 患者要求访问、更正错误并删除全部记录，同事说GDPR保证任何情况立即删除。按课件写平衡回复。
questions.answerEn: Access and correction are important rights, and erasure may apply in certain circumstances. The rights are not absolute. The organisation should review the request under the relevant context and legal basis, explain the outcome clearly and follow its governance process.
questions.answerZh: 访问、更正是重要权利，特定情况下可要求删除，但不是无条件权利。机构应按情境及法律依据审查，清楚说明结果并依治理流程处理。
questions.explanationZh: 课件明确不把GDPR权利教成绝对规则；不能编造本案例必须删除或必须保留的法律结论。
rubric: 清楚回应与治理流程（1分）

questions.promptEn: At one date, a town has 240 existing diabetes cases among 6,000 residents. Calculate point prevalence as a fraction, percentage and per 1,000 people. Explain one planning use.
questions.promptZh: 某时点镇上6000居民中已有240名糖尿病患者。算现患率的小数、百分比及每千人表示，并说明一项规划用途。
questions.answerEn: 240 ÷ 6,000 = 0.04 = 4% = 40 per 1,000 residents. The clinic can use the current burden to plan medication supply or staffing.
questions.answerZh: 240÷6000＝0.04＝4%＝每千人40人。可据当前负担规划药物、人员或长期支持。
questions.explanationZh: 同一时点已有病例除以同期居民人数；不要只用当期新病例。

questions.promptEn: County A has 100 existing cases among 10,000 people; County B has 20 among 1,000 at the same date. Calculate prevalence in each and identify the higher burden proportion. State two checks before treating the comparison as fair.
questions.promptZh: 同一天A县100/10000例，B县20/1000例。计算现患率，判断哪个比例较高，并列出公平比较前两项检查。
questions.answerEn: A: 1%. B: 2%. B has the higher prevalence proportion despite fewer cases. Check that case definitions, data sources and denominator rules are comparable; also examine relevant subgroups.
questions.answerZh: A为1%，B为2%。B虽然病例更少，现患比例更高。应检查病例定义、来源、分母规则等一致，并考虑相关亚组。
questions.explanationZh: 原始病例数不能直接表示比例。两县绝对服务需求仍可受总病例数影响，不要把比例与总需求混为一谈。

questions.promptEn: A hospital reports fewer medication errors after a new form is introduced. However, nurses say the form is hard to complete and many fields are blank. Explain a system-focused review using people, processes and technology.
questions.promptZh: 新表格上线后医院记录的用药错误减少，但护士说难填且多字段空白。用人、流程、技术解释如何检查。
questions.answerEn: Fewer recorded errors may reflect poorer recording. Ask staff about workflow, observe when and by whom fields are completed, review form design and system access, and check missing data and audit records. Improve the process before claiming that true errors fell.
questions.answerZh: 记录减少可能只是更少记录。访谈员工，观察谁在何时填表，检查表格设计、系统权限、缺失情况与日志。改进流程后再判断真实错误是否减少。
questions.explanationZh: 数据产生于工作流程；不能看到数字下降就归功于干预，也不能只责怪个人。
rubric: 记录量与真实情况区别（1分）

questions.promptEn: The clinician’s medication list says a drug is prescribed, pharmacy data show it was dispensed and a portal message says the patient never took it. Are these necessarily contradictory errors? Explain and identify a useful data-governance response.
questions.promptZh: 医生用药清单有处方、药房显示已配药，但患者门户留言说从未服用。这一定是互相矛盾的错误吗？说明并提出治理回应。
questions.answerEn: Not necessarily. A prescription records an intended treatment, dispensing records supply and a patient report describes actual use. Keep source and meaning clear, reconcile the information for care and set responsibilities for quality review and correction.
questions.answerZh: 不一定。处方记录计划，配药记录供应，自报反映实际使用。保留来源和语义，核对照护资料，并明确质量复核及更正职责。
questions.explanationZh: 同一患者在不同流程中有不同视角；简单覆盖某一记录可能丢掉有用信息。

Data → Information → Knowledge → Action 

Data: individual observations
Information: organized data with context
Knowledge: interpretation using evidence
Action: a decision or intervention
slides.notes: Example: “120 people missed appointments” is data. “Missed appointments increased in one neighborhood” is information. “Transportation may be a barrier” is an interpretation. “Offer transit vouchers and evening appointments” is action. Each step adds judgment and assumptions.

Health Data Is More Than Medical Data 

Health data can describe:

Biology and clinical care
Behaviors and experiences
Social and economic conditions
Environment, place, and policy
Health-system access and quality
slides.notes: Explain that public health looks beyond diagnoses and prescriptions. Housing instability, food access, transportation, discrimination, pollution, insurance coverage, and trust in institutions can all influence health outcomes.

Quantitative Data 

Quantitative data use numbers to describe:

Counts: number of clinic visits
Measurements: blood pressure, height, weight
Amounts: dollars spent, minutes waited
Rates and percentages
slides.notes: Clarify that not every number is quantitative. A ZIP code, patient identification number, or medical-record number may contain digits, but those digits are labels—not quantities that should be averaged.

¢ Amounts: dollars spent, minutes waited

¢ Rates and percentages

slides.text:
Discrete and Continuous Data 

Discrete: countable whole numbers 
Example: 3 emergency visits
Continuous: measured values on a scale 
Example: body temperature (e.g., 37.2, 39.3, 40.5)
Units and precision matter
slides.notes: A person may have 0, 1, or 2 hospitalizations, but not 1.6 hospitalizations. Temperature can theoretically take many values within a range. Explain that data may be rounded, such as a weight recorded to the nearest pound.

Qualitative Data 

Qualitative data capture:

Words and stories
Feelings and lived experiences
Interview responses
Focus-group discussions
Open-ended survey answers
slides.notes: Emphasize that qualitative data are not “less scientific.” Qualitative methods can be systematic and rigorous. Researchers use structured interviews, coding frameworks, themes, multiple reviewers, and documentation of how conclusions were reached.

Categorical Data: Labels and Groups 

Nominal: no natural order 
Example: insurance type, school type (primary, secondary, university)
Ordinal: ordered categories 
Example: poor / fair / good / excellent
Binary: two categories 
Example: yes / no
slides.notes: Explain that ordinal categories have an order, but the distance between categories is not necessarily equal. The difference between “poor” and “fair” may not be the same as the difference between “good” and “excellent.”

What Is an Electronic Health Record? 

An EHR is:

A digital health record created over time
Used across care encounters
Accessible to authorized users
A source of clinical and administrative data
slides.notes:
Explain that an EHR can include diagnoses, medications, allergies, notes, laboratory results, vital signs, imaging, and billing-related information. It supports care delivery first; research and public-health uses are often secondary uses of data.
Source footer: U.S. health IT guidance describes EHRs as longitudinal digital records containing information such as diagnoses, medications, notes, laboratory results, and other patient information accessible to authorized users. (healthit.gov)

EHR vs. EMR vs. Personal Health Record 

EMR (Electronic Medical Record): usually centered in one practice or organization
HER (Electronic Health Record): intended to support information sharing across settings

slides.text:
Meaning of “Triage”

Triage is the process of quickly assessing patients and deciding who needs medical attention first. It is based on the seriousness and urgency of a person’s condition, not simply on who arrived first.

For example, a patient with difficulty breathing would usually be treated before someone with a minor cut.

Often timely

Supports care coordination
Useful for quality improvement

Designing Better Survey Questions

Good questions are:

Clear and specific
Neutral, not leading
Focused on one idea
Time-bounded
Written in accessible language
slides.notes: Avoid double-barreled questions such as, “How often do you exercise and eat healthy foods?” A person may exercise often but not eat healthy foods. Avoid vague wording such as “regularly” unless you define it.

slides.text:
Survey Strengths and Trade-Offs 

Surveys can be:
Fast and efficient
Anonymous
Easy to compare across respondents

But may have:
Nonresponse bias
Recall bias
Social-desirability bias
Misunderstood questions
slides.notes:
Ask students: “Who may be least likely to answer?” This question is often more important than asking only how many people answered. A high number of responses does not automatically mean the sample represents the intended population.
Source footer: CDC materials note that surveys can efficiently gather standardized information from many people, while also facing risks such as nonrepresentative samples, lower response, self-report limitations, and misunderstood questions. (stacks.cdc.gov)

Law: required minimum standards
Policy: organizational rules and procedures
Ethics: fairness, rights, harm, trust, and accountability
Ask both: “Can we?” and “Should we?”
slides.notes: A data practice might be legal but still harmful or untrustworthy. For example, a technically lawful use of neighborhood data may still reinforce stigma if the community is excluded from decisions and receives no benefit.

Privacy, Confidentiality, and Security 

Privacy: a person’s control and expectations
Confidentiality: duty not to disclose entrusted information
Security: safeguards against unauthorized access or loss
slides.notes: Use a simple example. Privacy concerns whether a person’s health information should be collected or shared. Confidentiality concerns whether a staff member keeps it private. Security includes passwords, encryption, access controls, physical safeguards, and audit logs.

Respect for persons: autonomy and informed choice
Beneficence: maximize benefits and reduce harm
Justice: fair distribution of burdens and benefits

Explain that the Belmont principles are central to U.S. human-subjects research ethics. They are also useful as a practical lens for data projects: Who has a choice? Who benefits? Who bears the risks? Who is excluded?

GDPR: A High-Level Introduction 

GDPR is a personal-data protection framework that:

Treats health data as sensitive
Requires a lawful basis for processing
Adds conditions for special-category data
Requires fact-specific legal interpretation
slides.notes:
Avoid presenting GDPR as “European HIPAA.” It is broader and organized differently. Applicability can depend on the people involved, the organization’s activities, the data, and where processing occurs. Teach this as a conceptual comparison, not legal advice.

chapters.titleZh: 描述统计：从变量、图形到可靠报告

studyNotes.title: Variable types: measurement, category, date and derivation
studyNotes.explanationZh: 类别变量用于分组，例如 sex、hypertension_status、BMI_category；数值变量表示数量或测量，例如年龄、BMI、血压、胆固醇、血糖、运动量和饮酒量。visit_date 是日期。bmi_calc 和 BMI_final 是衍生变量。注意：“衍生”说明变量的来源，“数值/类别”说明变量的类型，两者并不互斥。BMI_final 是衍生的数值变量，BMI_category 是从 BMI 产生的类别变量。把 BMI 分类方便沟通，却会失去同一类别内的具体差异，因此应保留两者。
studyNotes.simpleEn: Numerical variables measure amounts. Categorical variables group records. Keep both BMI values and BMI groups because grouping loses detail.
examFocus: Recognise categorical, numerical, date and derived variables.
Explain why BMI_final and BMI_category are both useful.
studyNotes.pitfall: 不要把由数字编码的类别当作连续测量，也不要把“衍生变量”当成与数值变量互斥的类型。
studyNotes.visualExplanation: 原页 SmartArt 把变量列成四组；这些文字储存在图表 XML 内。

studyNotes.title: Prepare a reliable output location
studyNotes.explanationZh: 先按操作系统找到 Desktop 路径：Windows 读取 USERPROFILE，其他系统读取 HOME；file.path() 组合路径。若该目录不存在，代码把输出位置改为 getwd() 所表示的当前工作目录，并显示实际位置。save_msg() 只打印保存提示，并不负责写文件。路径准备属于可重复分析的一部分，不能因为没有在桌面找到文件就断言分析失败。
studyNotes.simpleEn: Use file.path() to build a path. If Desktop is missing, the script uses the working directory. Check the printed output location.
examFocus: Explain .Platform$OS.type, Sys.getenv(), file.path() and getwd().
Distinguish a saved file from a printed save message.
studyNotes.pitfall: save_msg() 只打印消息；真正写文件的是 write.csv()、png() 等操作。

studyNotes.title: Section 2: Quick Look
studyNotes.explanationZh: 本页只有“Section 2 — Quick Look”章节标题，没有具体代码、图像或讲者备注。它标示进入初步查看数据的阶段；复习时把它连接到变量识别和后续描述统计即可。本资料不会把其他未列入范围的页面内容伪称为本页原文。
studyNotes.simpleEn: This slide marks the Quick Look section. It contains a heading only.
examFocus: Place an initial data review before detailed description.
Connect the heading to the variable types on slide 11.
studyNotes.pitfall: 不要仅凭这个标题背诵不存在于本页的特定 R 命令。

studyNotes.title: BMI calculation and BMI_final priority
studyNotes.explanationZh: 公式：BMI = 体重(kg) / 身高(m)²；身高若以 cm 记录，先除以 100。bmi_calc 是重算值；BMI_final 优先使用原 BMI，只有原 BMI 缺失时才用可计算的 bmi_calc。原 BMI 和重算值均保留，可追踪数据处理并检查差异。BMI 适合群体筛查及描述，不能独自代表个人健康或身体组成。
studyNotes.simpleEn: BMI = weight in kilograms divided by height in metres squared. BMI_final uses the original BMI when available; otherwise it uses the calculated BMI.
examFocus: Calculate BMI with correct units.
Apply the original-first fallback rule.
Explain the audit trail and limits of BMI.
studyNotes.pitfall: 不要把 cm 直接平方；不要假设脚本自动用重算值覆盖所有原 BMI。
studyNotes.visualExplanation: 公式图片写明 BMI_final 的原值优先规则。

studyNotes.title: Mean, median and mode
studyNotes.explanationZh: 平均数等于总和除以个数；中位数先排序再找中间，偶数个时取中间两个数的平均；众数是出现次数最多的值。极大或极小值可明显拉动平均数，中位数通常较稳定。BMI 等连续测量经常没有重复的精确值，因此某个精确数值的众数可能不具代表性；必要时说明无唯一众数。
studyNotes.simpleEn: The mean is the average. The median is the middle ordered value. The mode is the most common value. Extreme values affect the mean more strongly.
examFocus: Calculate mean, median and mode.
Choose and justify a measure when values are skewed.
studyNotes.pitfall: 中位数必须先排序；不要把“中位数较稳健”写成“平均数永远不应报告”。

studyNotes.title: Negative excess kurtosis: equal-frequency example
studyNotes.explanationZh: 图中 65 至 135 每隔 5 一个数，每个值都出现 10 次，频数均匀且左右对称。图示峰度为 −1.21，采用超额峰度口径（正态参照为 0），说明相对正态分布尾部较轻。对称性解释偏度为 0；偏度为 0 并不表示分布一定正态。
studyNotes.simpleEn: The equal-frequency distribution is symmetric, so its skewness is zero. Its excess kurtosis is −1.21, indicating lighter tails than a normal distribution.
examFocus: Read frequency labels and symmetry.
Explain negative excess kurtosis.
Distinguish symmetry from normality.
studyNotes.pitfall: “峰度为负”必须说明是超额峰度；不能据此推断标准差一定较小。
studyNotes.visualExplanation: 横轴 65–135，间隔 5，共 15 个值；每值频数 10，总样本数 150。

studyNotes.title: Positive excess kurtosis: heavy-tail example
studyNotes.explanationZh: 图中多数观测集中在约 95–105，同时两侧仍有远离中心的观测，图示超额峰度为 +1.86，表示比正态参照有更重的尾部。该图仍左右对称，所以重尾可以与零偏度同时存在。重尾与右偏是不同概念。
studyNotes.simpleEn: The figure has positive excess kurtosis of 1.86. It is symmetric with heavier tails than the normal reference.
examFocus: Interpret positive excess kurtosis.
Explain how symmetry and heavy tails can coexist.
studyNotes.pitfall: 不要把正峰度等同于右偏；峰度描述尾部特征，偏度描述不对称方向。
studyNotes.visualExplanation: 图形中心频数较高，两端仍有观测；左右柱形大致对称。

studyNotes.title: Kurtosis conventions and diagram limits
studyNotes.explanationZh: 该图以 K=0 标示正态分布，使用超额峰度口径：leptokurtic 为正，mesokurtic 为 0，platykurtic 为负。记忆重点是相对尾重，不能只看曲线峰高。图上的“less variability / highly dispersed”是简化图示，不能推出峰度决定标准差；尺度变化可以改变标准差而不改变标准化峰度。与第 52 页代码比较时必须核对是否减去 3。
studyNotes.simpleEn: On the excess-kurtosis scale, normal is zero. Positive values indicate heavier tails and negative values indicate lighter tails. Check the definition before comparing values.
examFocus: Name leptokurtic, mesokurtic and platykurtic.
State the normal reference on each kurtosis scale.
Avoid reading SD directly from kurtosis.
studyNotes.pitfall: 原始峰度的正态参照约 3，超额峰度的参照为 0；两种口径不能混用。
studyNotes.visualExplanation: 图片列出三类分布并用 K>0、K=0、K<0 标记；原页还有视频链接，备注含 Minitab 解释链接。

studyNotes.title: Read the skewness and kurtosis R code
studyNotes.explanationZh: 代码用 my_col 选取列，再用 as.numeric() 转数值、na.omit() 去除缺失值。偏度来自三次中心距；图示 physical activity 偏度 0.53，右尾较长，红色平均数线在绿色中位数线右侧。代码的四次中心距式为 sum((x-mean(x))^4)/(length(x)*sd(x)^4)，没有减 3，因此图示 2.95 不是第 42–44 页那种超额峰度。按相同估计式减 3 得 −0.05；这只是口径转换。R 的 sd() 使用样本标准差，因此小样本值还会受估计方式影响。png() 打开图形文件，dev.off() 关闭并完成输出。
studyNotes.simpleEn: The code selects a numeric column, removes missing values, calculates skewness and kurtosis, and saves a histogram. Its kurtosis formula does not subtract 3.
examFocus: Read column selection, missing-value removal and plot-saving code.
Interpret skewness 0.53 and the mean/median lines.
Distinguish the displayed kurtosis 2.95 from excess kurtosis.
studyNotes.pitfall: 不能把 2.95 当作超额峰度来声称极重尾；也不能用接近 3 就证明数据正态。
studyNotes.visualExplanation: 图标题为 Physical Activity，Skewness 0.53，Kurtosis 2.95；红线 mean，深绿线 median。

studyNotes.title: Build the descriptive table
studyNotes.explanationZh: desc_list <- lapply(df[vars_to_describe], get_stats) 把 get_stats 应用到所选的每一列。表中包括年龄、BMI_final、收缩压、舒张压、胆固醇、空腹血糖及运动量。BMI_final 可用身高体重补充原 BMI 的缺失，因此优于直接只用原 BMI。备注特别指出：饮酒量虽已转数值，但不在这张描述表内，之后才用于相关分析。
studyNotes.simpleEn: lapply() applies get_stats to each selected variable. The table uses BMI_final. Alcohol use is not included in this descriptive table.
examFocus: Explain lapply() in this context.
Name the summarized variables.
Distinguish numeric conversion from inclusion in a specific analysis.
studyNotes.pitfall: 数值型变量不等于一定被 vars_to_describe 选中；不能误称此表含饮酒量。

studyNotes.title: What histograms reveal
studyNotes.explanationZh: 直方图用于数值变量，横轴为相邻数值区间，柱通常相接。它显示数值集中位置、对称或偏斜、离群候选值、缺口、多峰及分散程度。与类别条形图不同，柱对应的是连续数值区间。备注中的脚本采用 20 个 bins；改变分箱可能改变视觉印象，所以要结合统计量判断。
studyNotes.simpleEn: A histogram shows a numerical distribution. Check concentration, spread, shape, gaps and peaks. The number of bins can change its appearance.
examFocus: Choose histogram versus bar chart.
Explain bin sensitivity.
studyNotes.pitfall: 直方图看起来平滑或出现两个峰，都可能受分箱影响，不能只凭一张图下定论。

studyNotes.title: Read center, spread, shape, peaks and extremes
studyNotes.explanationZh: 按五点顺序读图：中心在哪里、范围宽窄、对称还是偏斜、一个峰或多个峰、是否有极端值。右偏表示长尾朝较大值，左偏表示长尾朝较小值；不能根据最高的柱子位于哪边来命名偏斜。再对照平均数、中位数、SD 和 IQR，核对图像解释。
studyNotes.simpleEn: Read the center, spread, shape, peaks and extreme values. A right-skewed distribution has a longer tail toward larger values.
examFocus: Identify tail direction.
Combine a histogram with mean, median, SD and IQR.
studyNotes.pitfall: 右偏常见平均数大于中位数，但这是常见关系，不能写成对所有可能分布的绝对定律。

studyNotes.title: Rivertown: averages can hide health patterns
studyNotes.explanationZh: 该案例提醒：总体平均 BMI 和血压看似良好，仍可能掩盖高风险尾部或不同亚群。应查看直方图的形状、尾部和多峰，并结合描述表；有合理分组变量时可进一步按组查看。图像提示潜在模式，不能单独证明某亚群的身份、病因或因果关系。
studyNotes.simpleEn: A healthy-looking average can hide high values or different subgroups. Use distributions and summary statistics together.
examFocus: Explain why a single average is insufficient.
Propose and qualify an exploratory interpretation.
studyNotes.pitfall: 多峰只能提示可能存在不同群组，不能仅凭图形就认定群组身份或原因。

studyNotes.title: Boxplot anatomy and potential outliers
studyNotes.explanationZh: 箱内中线是中位数，箱体从 Q1 到 Q3，覆盖中间 50%，IQR=Q3−Q1。标准 R 箱线图用 Q1−1.5×IQR 和 Q3+1.5×IQR 作为离群判断界限；须线伸到界限内实际存在的最远数据点，通常不正好等于界限。须外点是潜在离群值，可能是真实观测。原图的须端标作 minimum/maximum，只有这些极值没有被单独标为离群点时才可这样理解。
studyNotes.simpleEn: The line is the median. The box contains the central 50%. In a standard R boxplot, values beyond the 1.5 × IQR limits are potential outliers.
examFocus: Calculate IQR and outlier fences.
Distinguish fences, whiskers and observed minimum/maximum.
Explain why outliers require checking.
studyNotes.pitfall: 不要说每个箱线图的须一定等于全体最小值及最大值；不要自动删除须外点。
studyNotes.visualExplanation: 原图为 Test scores，箱体约 78–91，中位数约 84，须端约 67 和 98；读数仅为图像近似。

studyNotes.title: Report boxplots responsibly
studyNotes.explanationZh: 报告应命名群组、比较中位数、比较 IQR 或分散程度及分布重叠、说明潜在离群值，并尽可能交代每组人数。组 A 的中位数较高不表示所有 A 成员都高于 B，也不证明组别造成结果。图形主要帮助描述和比较，不自动提供显著性检验。
studyNotes.simpleEn: Name the groups, compare medians and spread, describe overlap and outliers, and report group sizes when possible. Avoid causal claims.
examFocus: Write a short comparison with appropriate limits.
Distinguish group summaries from individual certainty.
studyNotes.pitfall: 两组箱体重叠或不重叠本身都不能代替正式统计检验。

studyNotes.title: Save a cleaned dataset and keep an audit trail
studyNotes.explanationZh: cleaned_path <- file.path(desktop, "rivertown_cleaned_for_teaching.csv") 指定清洗后副本；write.csv(df, cleaned_path, row.names=FALSE) 写入数据且不额外保存行号。save_msg(cleaned_path) 显示保存位置。保留原始数据，并记录 BMI 补算、分类及其他实际转换，才能重复分析和追踪差异；不能让清洗副本无说明地替代原始文件。
studyNotes.simpleEn: write.csv() saves a cleaned copy. row.names = FALSE avoids an extra row-name column. Keep the raw file and record the changes.
examFocus: Explain write.csv() and row.names=FALSE.
Describe raw/cleaned separation and a transformation log.
studyNotes.pitfall: 写出 CSV 不等于所有清洗都正确；保存提示也不能代替核对实际文件与处理记录。

questions.promptEn: Which variable is categorical?
questions.promptZh: 哪一个是类别变量？
questions.answerEn: BMI_category.
questions.answerZh: BMI_category。
questions.explanationZh: BMI 数值是测量；BMI_category 把测量归入组别。

questions.promptEn: Why should the analysis keep both BMI_final and BMI_category?
questions.promptZh: 为什么同时保留 BMI_final 和 BMI_category？
questions.answerEn: BMI_final keeps measurement detail. BMI_category makes group summaries easier. Categorising loses detail.
questions.answerZh: BMI_final 保留精确测量；BMI_category 方便分组和沟通；分类会丢失细节。
questions.explanationZh: 同类别内可以包含不同 BMI 数值，只保留类别便无法恢复这些差异。
rubric: 指出分类的信息损失 1 分。

questions.promptEn: If the Desktop folder does not exist, where does the script save outputs?
questions.promptZh: Desktop 文件夹不存在时，脚本使用哪里保存？
questions.answerEn: The current working directory returned by getwd().
questions.answerZh: getwd() 返回的当前工作目录。
questions.explanationZh: 代码先检查 dir.exists(desktop)，不存在则 desktop <- getwd()。

questions.promptEn: What does file.path() do, and why is it useful?
questions.promptZh: file.path() 有什么作用？为什么有用？
questions.answerEn: It joins path components using suitable separators, helping the script work across operating systems.
questions.answerZh: 按适当分隔符组合路径，减少跨系统手写斜线错误。
questions.explanationZh: 它创建路径字符串；不会单凭调用就创建目录或写出文件。
rubric: 跨系统/减少分隔符错误 1 分。

questions.promptEn: A person weighs 72 kg and is 180 cm tall. Calculate BMI to one decimal place.
questions.promptZh: 一人体重 72 kg、身高 180 cm，计算 BMI，保留一位小数。
questions.answerEn: Height = 1.80 m. BMI = 72 / 1.80² = 22.2 kg/m².
questions.explanationZh: 本题数据为原创练习。先转换单位，再平方身高。

questions.promptEn: Original BMI is 24.0 and bmi_calc is 23.5. What does the stated BMI_final rule return?
questions.promptZh: 原 BMI 为 24.0，bmi_calc 为 23.5，按本页规则 BMI_final 是多少？
questions.answerEn: 24.0, because the original BMI is available.
questions.answerZh: 24.0，因为原 BMI 非缺失。
questions.explanationZh: 本题数据为原创练习；脚本的原值优先规则不等于证明原值一定更准确，差异仍可审查。

questions.promptEn: For values 20, 22, 22, 24, 32, find the mean, median and mode.
questions.promptZh: 计算 20、22、22、24、32 的平均数、中位数和众数。
questions.answerEn: Mean = 24; median = 22; mode = 22.
questions.answerZh: 总和 120，平均数 24；中位数 22；众数 22。
questions.explanationZh: 本题为原创数据。排序后第三个值为 22，22 也出现最多次。

questions.promptEn: Which measure is usually more resistant to a few extreme values?
questions.promptZh: 哪个指标通常较不受少量极端值影响？
questions.answerEn: The median.
questions.answerZh: 中位数。
questions.explanationZh: 平均数使用所有数值的大小，极端值会拉动它；中位数主要由排序位置决定。

questions.promptEn: Slide 42 shows excess kurtosis of −1.21. What is the best interpretation?
questions.promptZh: 第 42 页超额峰度为 −1.21，最佳解释是什么？
questions.answerEn: Lighter tails than the normal reference.
questions.answerZh: 相对正态参照尾部较轻。
questions.explanationZh: 这里使用超额峰度，正态参照是 0；负值与负偏度不是一回事。
options: A longer left tail must be present.
Lighter tails than the normal reference.

questions.promptEn: Can a distribution be symmetric and have positive excess kurtosis?
questions.promptZh: 一个分布可以同时对称且超额峰度为正吗？
questions.answerEn: Yes. Symmetry and tail weight are different properties.
questions.answerZh: 可以。对称性和尾部轻重是不同性质。
questions.explanationZh: 第 43 页就是对称、正超额峰度的例子。
options: No, positive kurtosis always means right skew.
No, every symmetric distribution is normal.
Yes, symmetry and tail weight are different.
Only if all values are identical.

questions.promptEn: State the normal reference for raw kurtosis and excess kurtosis.
questions.promptZh: 分别写出原始峰度和超额峰度的正态参照值。
questions.answerEn: Raw kurtosis has a normal reference of 3. Excess kurtosis has a normal reference of 0.
questions.answerZh: 原始峰度正态参照为 3；超额峰度正态参照为 0。
questions.explanationZh: 这是理论口径；样本估计数还会因样本量与具体估计式而变化。

questions.promptEn: The physical-activity plot shows skewness 0.53. What does the positive sign suggest?
questions.promptZh: 运动量图偏度为 0.53，正号提示什么？
questions.answerEn: A longer tail toward higher physical-activity values.
questions.answerZh: 朝较大运动量数值方向的尾部较长。
questions.explanationZh: 原图红色 mean 线也位于绿色 median 线右侧，与右偏相符。
options: A longer tail toward larger values.
A longer tail toward smaller values.
All observations are above the mean.

questions.promptEn: In desc_list <- lapply(df[vars_to_describe], get_stats), what does lapply() do?
questions.promptZh: 在该语句中，lapply() 做什么？
questions.answerEn: It applies get_stats to each selected column and returns the results as a list.
questions.answerZh: 把 get_stats 应用于每个选定列，结果组成列表。
questions.explanationZh: 逐列统计不等于逐行统计；选择哪些列取决于 vars_to_describe。
rubric: 对所选每列应用函数 1 分。

questions.promptEn: Which numeric variable is explicitly excluded from the descriptive table on slide 56?
questions.promptZh: 第 56 页备注明确哪项数值变量不在该描述表内？
questions.answerEn: Alcohol use.
questions.answerZh: 饮酒量。
questions.explanationZh: 备注说明饮酒量虽已转数值，但之后用于相关分析，并未列入该描述表。

questions.promptEn: Which plot is most suitable for the distribution of numerical BMI values?
questions.promptZh: 查看数值型 BMI 的分布，哪种图最合适？
questions.answerEn: A histogram.
questions.answerZh: 直方图。
questions.explanationZh: 直方图按相邻数值区间展示频数；类别条形图展示不同类别。
options: A bar chart of unrelated labels
A pie chart of every exact BMI value

questions.promptEn: Name five features to check in a histogram.
questions.promptZh: 列出读直方图时应检查的五项特征。
questions.answerEn: Center, spread, shape, peaks and extreme values.
questions.answerZh: 中心、分散程度、形状、峰数、极端值。
questions.explanationZh: 应按这些维度具体解释图形，并与描述表核对。

questions.promptEn: Why can a healthy-looking average hide health risks?
questions.promptZh: 为什么看似良好的平均数仍可能掩盖健康风险？
questions.answerEn: An average can hide high-risk tails or different subgroups. Inspect the distribution as well.
questions.answerZh: 平均数可能掩盖高风险尾部或不同亚群，因此也要查看分布。
questions.explanationZh: 第 85 页 Rivertown 案例没有提供具体风险人数，不能自行编造其实际比例。
rubric: 提到尾部或亚群 1 分。

questions.promptEn: A boxplot has Q1 = 22 and Q3 = 30. Find its IQR.
questions.promptZh: 箱线图 Q1=22、Q3=30，求 IQR。
questions.explanationZh: 本题为原创数据；IQR 衡量中间 50% 数据的跨度。

questions.promptEn: Name four things to include when reporting two boxplots.
questions.promptZh: 比较两张箱线图时，列出至少四项应报告内容。
questions.answerEn: Name the groups and compare medians, spread, overlap and possible outliers. Report group sizes when available.
questions.answerZh: 群组名称、中位数、分散程度、重叠、潜在离群值；有资料时报告组人数。
questions.explanationZh: 至少四项即可，因果结论或“所有人都不同”不是合适的报告内容。
rubric: 每个正确项目 1 分，上限 4 分。

questions.promptEn: What does row.names = FALSE do in write.csv()?
questions.promptZh: write.csv() 的 row.names=FALSE 有什么作用？
questions.answerEn: It avoids writing an extra row-name column.
questions.answerZh: 不额外写出行名列。
questions.explanationZh: 它不会删除真实的 ID 变量列，也不表示删除数据行。

questions.promptEn: A student labels BMI_final as numerical, BMI_category as categorical, and says derived variables cannot be numerical. Correct the statement and explain one cost of categorising BMI.
questions.promptZh: 学生说 BMI_final 是数值、BMI_category 是类别，但“衍生变量不可能是数值”。纠正并解释 BMI 分类的一个代价。
questions.answerEn: BMI_final is both derived and numerical. BMI_category is derived and categorical. Derivation describes origin; numerical/categorical describes type. Categorising loses differences within groups.
questions.answerZh: BMI_final 既是衍生变量也是数值变量；BMI_category 既是衍生变量也是类别变量。衍生说明来源，数值/类别说明类型；分类会丢失组内差异。
questions.explanationZh: 本题为原创概念辨析，依据第 11 页 SmartArt 和备注作进一步理解。
rubric: BMI_final 两属性正确 1 分。
BMI_category 两属性正确 1 分。
区分来源与类型 1 分。

questions.promptEn: After running setup, a student cannot find the CSV on Desktop. The code printed a different working-directory path. Give three checks before rerunning the whole analysis.
questions.promptZh: 运行后桌面没有 CSV，代码打印了另一个工作目录。重跑全部分析前应做哪三项检查？
questions.answerEn: Check the printed output path and whether Desktop exists. Check that write.csv() actually ran without error. Inspect the saved file in the fallback directory; a save message alone does not write it.
questions.answerZh: 核对打印路径及 Desktop 是否存在；确认 write.csv() 实际运行且无错误；到回退的工作目录检查文件，不能只凭 save_msg() 提示。
questions.explanationZh: 第 17 页路径规则与第 158 页保存步骤共同构成可复查输出流程。
rubric: 确认真正写入操作和错误 1 分。
核对实际输出文件 1 分。

questions.promptEn: Slide 20 is only a Quick Look heading. Before choosing a histogram or grouped boxplots, what two properties of the planned variables should you check?
questions.promptZh: 第 20 页只是 Quick Look 标题。在选择直方图或分组箱线图前，应检查变量的哪两类性质？
questions.answerEn: Check whether the outcome is numerical and whether any grouping variable is categorical. Also check the available measurements and missing values before summarising.
questions.answerZh: 确认结果变量是数值测量，并确认分组变量是类别；还可检查可用测量和缺失情况。
questions.explanationZh: 这是结合第 11、83、125 页生成的流程应用题；并非声称第 20 页列出特定 R 命令。
rubric: 确认数值结果变量 1 分。
确认类别分组变量 1 分。

questions.promptEn: Use the stated BMI_final rule. A: original BMI 25.0, weight 72 kg, height 180 cm. B: original BMI missing, weight 81 kg, height 180 cm. C: original BMI missing and height missing. Find BMI_final for A, B and C, and name one audit check.
questions.promptZh: 按 BMI_final 规则：A 原 BMI25.0、72kg、180cm；B 原 BMI 缺失、81kg、180cm；C 原 BMI 与身高均缺失。求三人的 BMI_final，并提出一项审计检查。
questions.answerEn: A = 25.0. B = 81 / 1.8² = 25.0. C remains missing because BMI cannot be calculated. Keep original and calculated values and review differences.
questions.answerZh: A=25.0，原值优先；B=81/3.24=25.0；C 仍缺失，无法补算。保留原值和重算值并检查差异。
questions.explanationZh: 本题为原创数据。A 的重算值约 22.2，不能擅自取代原值 25.0，但应把差异作为核查线索。
rubric: A 25.0 及原值优先 1 分。
B 单位与公式正确 1 分。

questions.promptEn: A student calculates BMI as 80 / 175² and concludes that the person is extremely underweight. Diagnose the error, give the correct BMI, and state one limit of the indicator.
questions.promptZh: 学生计算 BMI=80/175² 后断言此人极度偏瘦。指出错误，给正确 BMI，并说明一个指标限制。
questions.answerEn: Height was entered in centimetres instead of metres. BMI = 80 / 1.75² ≈ 26.1 kg/m². BMI alone does not fully measure individual health or body composition.
questions.answerZh: 身高未从 cm 转为 m。BMI=80/1.75²≈26.1 kg/m²；BMI 不能全面反映个人健康或身体组成。
questions.explanationZh: 本题为原创数据；这里只要求正确计算与限制，不补充未给出的临床分界或诊断。

questions.promptEn: For 18, 20, 21, 22, 24, calculate the mean and median. Replace 24 with 99 and recalculate. Explain which summary changed more.
questions.promptZh: 对 18、20、21、22、24 算平均数和中位数，再把 24 改成 99 重算，解释哪个变化更大。
questions.answerEn: Originally mean = 21 and median = 21. After replacement, mean = 36 and median = 21. The mean rises by 15 while the median is unchanged.
questions.answerZh: 原总和105，平均数21，中位数21；替换后总和180，平均数36，中位数21。平均数上升15，中位数未变。
questions.explanationZh: 本题为原创数据，说明极端值对平均数的拉动，而不是说中位数从不改变。
rubric: 解释平均数较受极端值影响 1 分。

questions.promptEn: BMI values are 22.11, 22.13, 22.17, 22.19 and 22.21. A program reports 22.11 as the mode. Is this a useful unique mode? Give a better summary.
questions.promptZh: BMI 为22.11、22.13、22.17、22.19、22.21，程序回报众数22.11。这是有用的唯一众数吗？给出更合适的总结。
questions.answerEn: No value occurs more often than another, so there is no unique mode. A function that returns the first tied value is not identifying a meaningful unique peak. Report mean or median, with spread.
questions.answerZh: 所有值频次相同，没有唯一众数；函数若在并列时返回第一个值，不代表有实质众数。应报告平均数或中位数，并配合分散程度。
questions.explanationZh: 本题为原创数据；不是断言讲义函数一定采用某种并列处理，而是解释题目给定的输出。
rubric: 指出无唯一众数 1 分。
解释任意并列输出限制 1 分。
提出均值/中位数及分散指标 1 分。

questions.promptEn: In slide 42, values 65 to 135 in steps of 5 each occur 10 times. Find the sample size, mean and median. Explain why zero skewness does not prove normality.
questions.promptZh: 第42页中65至135每隔5一个值、每值出现10次。求样本数、平均数和中位数，并解释零偏度不证明正态。
questions.answerEn: There are 15 distinct values, so n = 150. Symmetry gives mean = 100 and median = 100. The equal-frequency shape is not normal, although it is symmetric.
questions.answerZh: (135−65)/5+1=15个值，n=150；关于100对称，所以平均数100，中位数100。它是等频分布，虽对称却非正态。
questions.explanationZh: 题中数值来自第42页图片；分布形状与尾部信息需和偏度共同解释。
rubric: 对称不等于正态 1 分。

questions.promptEn: Two distributions are symmetric. A has excess kurtosis −1.21 and B has +1.86. Compare their tail behaviour and explain whether these values determine which has the larger SD.
questions.promptZh: 两个分布都对称，A超额峰度−1.21，B为+1.86。比较尾部，并说明能否据此确定谁的SD较大。
questions.answerEn: A is lighter-tailed than the normal reference; B is heavier-tailed. Both may have zero skewness. Kurtosis alone does not determine which has the larger SD.
questions.answerZh: A 相对正态尾较轻，B 较重；两者都可偏度为零；不能仅凭峰度确定哪个 SD 更大。
questions.explanationZh: 数字来自第42、43页。第44页曲线图关于分散程度的字样是简化说明，不能当普遍关系。
rubric: 对称/零偏度可并存 1 分。

questions.promptEn: A report compares slide 43 kurtosis 1.86 with slide 52 kurtosis 2.95 and says slide 52 has heavier tails because 2.95 is larger. Explain the problem and make the scale conversion for slide 52.
questions.promptZh: 报告把第43页1.86与第52页2.95直接比较，称2.95更大所以尾更重。解释问题，并换算第52页口径。
questions.answerEn: The definitions differ. Slide 43 uses excess kurtosis; slide 52 code does not subtract 3. Subtracting 3 from 2.95 gives −0.05 on its corresponding excess scale. Check estimator details before a precise comparison.
questions.answerZh: 两页口径不同。第43页是超额峰度；第52页代码未减3。2.95−3=−0.05，才是同一估计式对应的超额值。精确比较还需核对估计方式。
questions.explanationZh: 这是讲义中最易混淆的地方。样本 SD 分母及偏差修正也可能令软件结果不同。
rubric: 核对估计式/不能原数直比 1 分。

questions.promptEn: Apply exactly the slide 52 formulas to x = c(1, 2, 3). Use mean(x)=2 and sample sd(x)=1. Find skew and kurt to two decimals. Do not silently subtract 3.
questions.promptZh: 严格按第52页公式计算 x=c(1,2,3)，已知均值2、样本SD1。求skew和kurt，保留两位小数，不能自行减3。
questions.answerEn: skew = (−1 + 0 + 1)/(3×1³) = 0.00. kurt = (1 + 0 + 1)/(3×1⁴) = 0.67. The code does not calculate excess kurtosis.
questions.explanationZh: 本题为原创小样本代码运算；不要用“正态参照3”去替代具体代码结果，n与样本SD的组合也影响小样本估计。

questions.promptEn: The selected column contains "100", "150", "bad" and NA. Explain what na.omit(as.numeric(...)) keeps, and give one reporting precaution. Assume ordinary character-to-numeric conversion in R.
questions.promptZh: 选中列包含"100"、"150"、"bad"及NA。说明na.omit(as.numeric(...))会保留什么，并提出一项报告注意点。假设是R普通字符转数值。
questions.answerEn: It keeps numeric 100 and 150. "bad" becomes missing during conversion and the missing values are omitted. Report the number excluded and check conversion failures before interpreting the plot.
questions.answerZh: 保留数值100和150；"bad"转换为缺失，再与原NA一起排除。应核对转换失败并报告排除数量。
questions.explanationZh: 本题为原创代码情境。删除缺失可使分析样本数少于原始行数，图形不能自动代表全部记录。

questions.promptEn: A student adds alcohol use to the list of variables reported in the slide 56 descriptive table because it is numeric. Correct the claim and explain how the code controls inclusion.
questions.promptZh: 学生因饮酒量是数值变量，便声称第56页描述表一定包含它。纠正并解释代码如何决定包含哪些变量。
questions.answerEn: Numeric type does not ensure inclusion. vars_to_describe chooses the columns passed to lapply(). The notes say alcohol use is not in this table and is used later for correlation analysis.
questions.answerZh: 数值类型不保证进入该表；vars_to_describe 选定传给lapply()的列。备注说饮酒量不在此描述表，之后用于相关分析。
questions.explanationZh: 准确读懂选列比仅背变量类型更重要。
rubric: 数值型不等于纳入 1 分。
饮酒量本表排除/后续相关 1 分。

questions.promptEn: A histogram with 5 bins looks unimodal, but the same data with 40 bins looks irregular. What should the analyst do before claiming multiple health-risk groups?
questions.promptZh: 同一数据用5个bins像单峰，用40个bins显得不规则。断言存在多个健康风险群组前，应如何处理？
questions.answerEn: Compare sensible bin settings and the descriptive table. Check whether peaks are stable and whether suitable group information supports them. Describe possible patterns cautiously; a histogram alone cannot identify group membership or causes.
questions.answerZh: 比较合理分箱并对照描述表；看峰形是否稳定，再核对是否有分组资料支持。谨慎描述可能模式，单图不能确定群组身份或原因。
questions.explanationZh: 本题为原创情境，依据分箱敏感性与Rivertown案例。
rubric: 比较多种合理分箱 1 分。
对照统计量/分组资料 1 分。
限定群组与因果结论 1 分。

questions.promptEn: A health report gives only mean BMI = 25.0. Design a brief descriptive follow-up that can reveal a high-risk tail and possible subgroups without making causal claims.
questions.promptZh: 报告只给平均BMI25.0。设计简短描述分析，查看高值尾部与潜在亚群，并避免因果结论。
questions.answerEn: Plot a BMI histogram and describe center, spread, tail direction, peaks and extremes. Compare the mean with the median and report SD/IQR. If suitable groups exist, compare boxplots and group sizes. Treat patterns as descriptive.
questions.answerZh: 画BMI直方图，描述中心、分散、尾方向、峰与极端值；比较平均数和中位数并报告SD/IQR；有合适分组时比较箱线图及人数；只作描述性解释。
questions.explanationZh: 平均25.0是原创情境，没有真实尾部比例或分组数据，因此答案提出分析步骤而不编造结果。
rubric: 读尾/峰/极端值等 1 分。
均值中位数及分散指标 1 分。
合理分组箱线图/人数 1 分。

questions.promptEn: Use the standard 1.5 × IQR rule. Q1=20 and Q3=28; observed values range from 6 to 45. Values near the ends are 6, 9, 38 and 45. Find the fences and identify which listed values are potential outliers.
questions.promptZh: 用标准1.5×IQR规则：Q1=20、Q3=28，最小6最大45，边缘观测为6、9、38、45。求界限并指出这些值中的潜在离群点。
questions.answerEn: IQR=8. Lower fence=20−12=8; upper fence=28+12=40. Of the listed values, 6 and 45 are potential outliers; 9 and 38 are within the fences.
questions.answerZh: IQR=8；下界8，上界40；6和45为潜在离群值，9和38在界限内。
questions.explanationZh: 本题为原创数据。界限8/40不一定是须端；须端对应界限内最远的实际观测。

questions.promptEn: A standard R boxplot has Q1=20, Q3=28 and outliers at 6 and 45. The smallest non-outlier is 9 and largest non-outlier is 38. Where do the whiskers end, and should the outliers be deleted automatically?
questions.promptZh: 标准R箱线图Q1=20、Q3=28，6及45为须外点，非离群最小9最大38。须端在哪里？应自动删除6和45吗？
questions.answerEn: Whiskers end at observed 9 and 38, not at the fences 8 and 40. Do not delete outliers automatically; check validity, units and the data-generating context.
questions.answerZh: 须端为实际观测9和38，不是界限8和40。不能自动删除6及45，应查真实性、单位及采集情境。
questions.explanationZh: 本题为原创数据；扩展解释第106页原图“minimum/maximum”标记仅适用于相应情形。
rubric: 区分须端和界限 1 分。
不自动删并检查 1 分。

questions.promptEn: Group A has median BMI 28, Q1=24 and Q3=32 and n=40. Group B has median 25, Q1=22 and Q3=29 and n=200. The boxes overlap. Write a careful two-sentence comparison and one limitation.
questions.promptZh: A组BMI中位数28、Q1–Q3为24–32、n40；B组中位数25、Q1–Q3为22–29、n200。箱体重叠。用两句谨慎比较并写一项限制。
questions.answerEn: Group A had a higher median BMI (28 versus 25) and a slightly larger IQR (8 versus 7). The groups overlapped and had different sizes (40 versus 200); these summaries do not show that every A value is higher or that group membership causes BMI differences.
questions.answerZh: A组中位数较高（28比25），IQR略大（8比7）。两组有重叠、人数不同（40比200）；不能推断所有A成员更高或组别导致BMI差异。
questions.explanationZh: 本题为原创摘要数据。没有检验结果，不能补写“显著差异”。
rubric: 个体/因果/显著性限制 1 分。

questions.promptEn: A student says, "The boxes do not overlap, so the treatment caused improvement and p<0.05." Explain two unsupported claims and name two reporting items that remain useful.
questions.promptZh: 学生说：“箱体不重叠，所以治疗导致改善，而且p<0.05。”解释两项缺乏依据的结论，并写出两项仍应报告的信息。
questions.answerEn: Boxplot separation alone does not establish causation or a p-value. Report the groups and their medians, spread, overlap or outliers, and group sizes when available.
questions.answerZh: 箱线图分离本身不能建立因果，也不能给出p值。仍应报告群组、中位数、分散程度、重叠或离群点，以及可用的组人数。
questions.explanationZh: 本题为原创错误识别。图形用于描述，推断或因果结论需要额外证据。
rubric: 一项合理报告信息 1 分。
另一项合理报告信息 1 分。

questions.promptEn: The cleaned CSV is saved over the raw file and no changes are recorded. Explain the problem and give a three-part correction using the slide 158 workflow.
questions.promptZh: 清洗后CSV直接覆盖原始文件且无处理记录。解释问题，并按第158页流程给三项修正。
questions.answerEn: The original values and transformation history can no longer be checked. Preserve the raw file, save a separately named cleaned copy with write.csv(..., row.names=FALSE), and record transformations and the actual output location.
questions.answerZh: 原始值与转换过程无法核查。保留raw；用独立文件名及write.csv(...,row.names=FALSE)保存cleaned；记录处理步骤和实际保存位置。
questions.explanationZh: 本题为原创流程审查；清洗记录应包含实际执行的补算、分类和排除，不应虚构操作。
rubric: 解释追溯性损失 1 分。
记录转换和位置 1 分。

How to Read a Boxplot 

A boxplot shows:

Middle line: median
Box: central 50% of values
Box height: interquartile range (IQR)
Whiskers: typical range beyond the box
Individual points: possible outliers
slides.notes:
In standard R boxplots, points beyond the whiskers are potential outliers based on the 1.5 × IQR convention.
An outlier is not automatically a mistake. It may be a valid, unusual observation.
Boxplots are especially useful for comparing groups because they place distributions side by side.
