studyNotes.title: Choose a test from the variables / 根据变量选检验
studyNotes.explanationZh: 先确认结果变量是数值还是类别，再确认分组数量。BMI（数值）按性别两组比较，选独立样本 t 检验；疫苗接种状态与地区都是类别，选卡方独立性检验；PHQ-9 分数按三个或以上收入类别比较，选单因素 ANOVA。选方法也要检查研究设计与相应假设。
studyNotes.simpleEn: Choose the test from the outcome type, group type and study design. Use a t-test for two independent group means, chi-square for two categorical variables, and one-way ANOVA for three or more group means.
examFocus: 能够说明为什么选某检验
先说 outcome type，再说 groups
知道同一个变量在不同问题中可扮演不同角色
studyNotes.pitfall: 不要因为某个检验更熟悉，就忽略变量类型或独立性。

studyNotes.title: Hypotheses, p-values and effect size / 假设、p值与效应量
studyNotes.explanationZh: H₀ 通常表示总体无差异或无关联，H₁ 表示存在差异或关联。α=.05 是本课程使用的判断阈值。p 值是在 H₀ 及检验模型成立时，观察到目前或更极端结果的概率。p 值回答证据问题，效应量回答差异或关联有多大。显著性、实际意义及因果关系要分别讨论。
studyNotes.simpleEn: A p-value describes how unusual the data would be under H₀. It is not the probability that H₀ is true. Report effect size as well as statistical significance.
examFocus: 写出 H₀/H₁
p<.05 时 reject H₀；p>.05 时 fail to reject H₀
区分统计显著与实际重要
studyNotes.pitfall: p=.03 不是 H₀ 有3%机会为真；p>.05 也不能证明完全相等。

studyNotes.title: What a t-test compares / t检验比较什么
studyNotes.explanationZh: 本页说明用 t 检验比较两组连续健康指标的均值，例如血压、体重或恢复天数。本章实例使用独立组，不能直接套用于同一患者前后测量的配对资料。检验估计均值差异的统计证据，本身不能解释差异原因或保证干预有效。
studyNotes.simpleEn: An independent-samples t-test compares the means of two independent groups. A significant result alone does not explain why the groups differ.
examFocus: 核心对象是两组均值
健康数值指标举例
识别独立组与同一人重复测量的区别
studyNotes.pitfall: 讲义的 genuine/random wording 是教学简写；检验不是对真实差异作绝对证明。

studyNotes.title: BMI by sex: variables and hypotheses / BMI与性别的假设
studyNotes.explanationZh: 图中自变量为 sex（Male/Female），结果变量为 bmi。H₀: μMale=μFemale；H₁: μMale≠μFemale。因为问题只问是否有差异，没有预设方向，所以是双侧独立样本比较。这里的分组变量不表示性别被实验随机分配。
studyNotes.simpleEn: BMI is the numeric outcome and sex is the two-group variable. H₀: μMale = μFemale. H₁: μMale ≠ μFemale. This is a two-sided comparison.
examFocus: 识别 independent/grouping variable 与 dependent/outcome variable
用总体均值 μ 写假设
双侧不等于预设男性更高
studyNotes.pitfall: 不能在看到样本均值后才选择更容易显著的检验方向。
studyNotes.visualExplanation: 图中文字列出研究问题、两类变量和两条总体均值假设。

studyNotes.title: R t-test and Cohen’s d / R代码与效应量
studyNotes.explanationZh: 代码先把 sex 转为因子，水平顺序为 Male、Female，再用 t.test(bmi ~ sex, data=ttest_df) 比较 BMI 均值。图中输出为 Welch two-sample t-test；效应量另外按 pooled SD 计算：d=(meanMale−meanFemale)/pooledSD。原图 pooledSD≈4.040075，d≈.080598，表示均值差相对组内变异很小。Welch 检验与这项合并标准差的效应量计算是不同步骤。
studyNotes.simpleEn: The formula bmi ~ sex means BMI is compared across sex groups. Cohen’s d divides the mean difference by a pooled standard deviation. The sign follows the group order.
examFocus: 读懂 outcome ~ group
理解 factor levels 决定相减顺序
区分 t 检验与 Cohen’s d 的用途
studyNotes.pitfall: 不要把 d=.08 解释成8%患者受影响；它没有 BMI 原单位。
studyNotes.visualExplanation: 左侧代码创建 data frame、执行 t.test、计算 pooled_sd 与 cohen_d；右侧环境显示600人，Male270、Female330及效应量。

studyNotes.title: Read and save BMI output / 阅读与保存BMI输出
studyNotes.explanationZh: capture.output({...}, file=file.path(desktop, "ttest_bmi_by_sex_results.txt")) 将 cat/print 产生的报告保存到文本文件。图中男性 n=270，均值27.48259；女性 n=330，均值27.15697。Welch 检验 t=.98373、df=578.09、p=.3257；均值差 Male−Female 的95%区间为[-.3245018,.9757476]；d=.08059824。应结合方向、区间、p值与效应量写结论。
studyNotes.simpleEn: The output reports sample sizes, means, standard deviations, the Welch t-test, its confidence interval and Cohen’s d. capture.output saves printed results to a text file.
examFocus: 报告 N、mean、SD 与检验结果
区间包含0，与双侧检验结果一致
studyNotes.pitfall: capture.output 保存的是打印结果，不是模型对象或原始数据；p不显著不等于证明均值相等。
studyNotes.visualExplanation: 彩色箭头把左侧 cat/print 代码对应到右侧报告标题、描述统计、t检验和Cohen’s d。

studyNotes.title: BMI: connect output to boxplot / BMI数值结果与箱线图
studyNotes.explanationZh: 两组 BMI 箱体和散点重叠较多，图形与 p=.3257、d≈.081 的结果相符。箱内粗线通常为中位数，报告中的27.48259和27.15697是均值，不能当作箱线图粗线的精确数值。箱线图能帮助检查分布、异常值及差异方向，但不能代替统计检验或独立性检查。
studyNotes.simpleEn: The BMI distributions overlap strongly. The boxplot shows medians and spread, while the t-test compares means. Read the plot together with p-values and effect size.
examFocus: 图表与报告相互核对
区分箱线图中位数与 t检验均值
不能仅凭箱体重叠下统计结论
studyNotes.pitfall: 箱体重叠不是无差异的证明，箱体不重叠也不是任何研究中显著性的通用规则。
studyNotes.visualExplanation: 右侧男性、女性箱线图的中位线接近，个体散点广泛重叠。

studyNotes.title: PHQ-9 by vaccination: numerical report / 接种状态与PHQ-9输出
studyNotes.simpleEn: The unvaccinated group has a slightly higher sample mean PHQ-9 score. With p = .1081 and a confidence interval crossing zero, the study does not show a statistically significant mean difference at α = .05.
examFocus: 正确读取 No/Yes 顺序
均值差约.44分
把p值、区间和效应量联合解释
studyNotes.pitfall: 不要沿用讲者备注中的 BMI 字样；本页结果是 PHQ-9。
studyNotes.visualExplanation: 左侧 capture.output 代码输出 PHQ-9 报告；右侧列出 No/Yes 描述统计与 Welch 结果。

studyNotes.title: PHQ-9: careful public-health interpretation / PHQ-9结果的审慎解释
studyNotes.explanationZh: 箱线图两组中位数约为6，分布接近；样本均值 No=6.05、Yes=5.61，p=.1081>.05，因此不拒绝均值相等的H₀。适当写法是在这份资料中未发现统计显著的组间均值差异。不能推断接种对心理健康没有任何影响，也不能从观察性分组证明疫苗使PHQ-9变化。
studyNotes.simpleEn: There is no statistically significant mean PHQ-9 difference in this dataset at α = .05. This does not prove that vaccination has no effect on mental health.
examFocus: 简短英文结论
样本观察与总体推断有区别
结合d≈.14讨论差异幅度
studyNotes.pitfall: 没有显著差异不是等效性检验通过，也不表示两组每个人的分数相同。
studyNotes.visualExplanation: 两组箱线图和散点分布接近；黄色重点标示 is not statistically significant。

studyNotes.title: SBP by hypertension: report and direction / 血压输出与差异方向
studyNotes.simpleEn: Mean SBP is about 12.93 mmHg higher in the hypertension group. The negative t and d come from subtracting Yes from No. The two-sided p-value is very small.
examFocus: 科学计数法2.211e-10
负号是方向，不是无效或负面效果
注意两组样本量差异
studyNotes.pitfall: p值不是0；负 d 不代表差异较小。
studyNotes.visualExplanation: 右侧报告显示两组 N 相差较大，均值和整个均值差置信区间均指向 No组血压较低。

studyNotes.title: SBP: effect, boxplot and limits / 血压效应与解释边界
studyNotes.explanationZh: 高血压组的箱体和中位数整体较高，且 |d|≈1.20，支持观察到较大的标准化组间差异。p<.001 提供反对 H₀ 的强统计证据，但讲义中的 statistically undeniable 和 validating clinical diagnostic definitions 措辞过强。这项比较本身不能独立验证诊断准确性或证明因果关系；高血压分组的定义可能本就与血压相关。
studyNotes.simpleEn: The hypertension group has higher SBP in this sample, with a large standardized mean difference. The result is statistically significant, but it does not by itself validate a diagnosis or prove causation.
examFocus: 同时报告显著性与效应量
图示分布上移
用观察到的差异写结论，避免因果或诊断过度推论
studyNotes.pitfall: 临床重要性还需结合单位、情境和研究设计，不能只由p或d单独决定。
studyNotes.visualExplanation: Yes组橙色箱体高于No组蓝色箱体，图形方向与No−Yes为负一致。

studyNotes.title: Chi-square healthcare applications / 卡方检验的医疗应用
studyNotes.explanationZh: 图中举例包括治疗/对照组与治愈/未治愈、生活方式因素与疾病有无、不同部门与满意/不满意。它们都比较两个类别变量的关联。吸烟与支气管炎例子的p<.05可说明反对独立性H₀的统计证据，但不能仅据p值称关联强，更不能只凭该项检验确认因果风险因素。
studyNotes.simpleEn: Use chi-square to examine association between categorical variables, such as smoking status and bronchitis status. A small p-value does not by itself show a strong or causal association.
examFocus: 识别两个类别变量
区分关联显著、关联强度、因果关系
列举医疗应用
studyNotes.pitfall: 原图 strong association/confirming risk factor 是过度表述；强度要另看效应量及研究设计。
studyNotes.visualExplanation: 原图以三类医疗应用及500名患者的吸烟与支气管炎例子说明卡方用途。

studyNotes.title: Contingency table, chi-square and Cramér’s V / 列联表、卡方与关联强度
studyNotes.explanationZh: 代码先用 factor() 标记 neighborhood 和 vaccinated_covid 为类别，再用 table() 建立交叉计数表，chisq.test(tab) 检验独立性。H₀ 是两变量独立；H₁ 是存在关联。Cramér’s V=sqrt(χ²/[N×(min(r,c)−1)]) 表示关联强度，范围0至1。p值与V承担不同角色；列联表中应使用计数，且要检查检验适用性。
studyNotes.simpleEn: Create a count table with table(), test it with chisq.test(), and use Cramér’s V to describe association strength. The null hypothesis is that the two categorical variables are independent.
examFocus: 读懂 table→chisq.test→Cramér’s V 流程
区分N、行列数与卡方统计量
V无正负方向，p不衡量强度
studyNotes.pitfall: 本页备注重复BMI t检验说明，不适用于这里。图中的 DV~IV 与列联表是此脚本用法，不能理解为R只支持某一种接口。
studyNotes.visualExplanation: 绿色框说明类别变量、列联表、chisq.test与Cramér’s V，各自用途不同。

studyNotes.title: Diabetes by race/ethnicity: cautious inference / 糖尿病与族裔的审慎推断
studyNotes.explanationZh: 图中 Pearson 卡方p=.8225>.05。正确结论是在该资料和检验条件下，没有足够证据拒绝糖尿病状态与族裔独立的H₀。原图使用 Proves 不恰当，不显著不能证明独立或所有群体风险完全相同。柱状图是人数，White组人数较多，因此不能仅凭病例柱更高断言风险更高；需比较组内比例并考虑不确定性与其他因素。
studyNotes.simpleEn: With p = .8225, fail to reject the null of independence. This does not prove no association. Compare within-group proportions, since raw counts are affected by group size.
examFocus: 人数和患病比例的区别
管理建议要结合不确定性与其他证据
studyNotes.pitfall: 单个不显著结果不足以排除族裔相关研究或直接决定公共卫生资源分配。
studyNotes.visualExplanation: 各组并列柱显示 No/Yes 人数，样本量差异明显；人数较多的组可能两根柱都较高。

questions.promptEn: Which test matches a numeric BMI outcome compared between two independent sex groups?
questions.promptZh: 比较两个独立性别组的数值型BMI，应选什么检验？
questions.answerEn: Independent-samples t-test.
questions.answerZh: 独立样本t检验。
questions.explanationZh: BMI为数值结果，分组为两个独立类别，符合本页方法映射。
options: Cramér’s V as a hypothesis test

questions.promptEn: Vaccination status and neighborhood are both categorical. Which method is used to test their association?
questions.promptZh: 接种状态与居住地区均为类别变量，应怎样检验关联？
questions.answerEn: A chi-square test on a contingency table.
questions.answerZh: 对列联表做卡方独立性检验。
questions.explanationZh: 两个类别变量先交叉计数，再检验是否独立。
rubric: 选对列联表卡方检验（1分）
options: A chi-square test on a contingency table
A comparison of the tallest bars only

questions.promptEn: Which method on slide 7 compares mean PHQ-9 scores across three or more independent income categories?
questions.promptZh: 按第7页，比较三个或以上独立收入类别的PHQ-9均值用什么？
questions.answerEn: One-way ANOVA.
questions.answerZh: 单因素方差分析。
questions.explanationZh: 结果是数值型，分组超过两类，因此该表列出one-way ANOVA。
options: A two-group t-test without changing the question

questions.promptEn: What is the correct meaning of a p-value?
questions.promptZh: 哪项是p值的正确含义？
questions.answerEn: The probability of results at least this extreme, assuming H₀ and the test model are true.
questions.answerZh: 在H₀与检验模型成立时，出现目前或更极端结果的概率。
questions.explanationZh: 条件是H₀成立，不是算出H₀为真的概率。
options: The probability that H₀ is true
The size of the group difference
The probability of results at least this extreme, assuming H₀ and the test model are true

questions.promptEn: Write H₀ and H₁ for a two-sided comparison of mean BMI between males and females.
questions.promptZh: 写出男女平均BMI双侧比较的H₀和H₁。
questions.answerEn: H₀: μMale = μFemale. H₁: μMale ≠ μFemale.
questions.answerZh: H₀：男性与女性总体平均BMI相等；H₁：两者不相等。
questions.explanationZh: 假设针对总体参数，不是对已经观察到的样本均值作陈述。

questions.promptEn: Why is the BMI research question two-sided?
questions.promptZh: BMI研究问题为什么是双侧？
questions.answerEn: It asks whether means differ in either direction.
questions.answerZh: 因为问题允许任一组均值更高。
questions.explanationZh: 有差异表示不等于，不事先规定男性或女性更高。
options: Because there are two columns in the file
Because it asks whether means differ in either direction
Because the p-value is greater than .05

questions.promptEn: In t.test(bmi ~ sex, data = ttest_df), identify the outcome and grouping variable.
questions.promptZh: 解释R公式t.test(bmi ~ sex, data = ttest_df)中的结果与分组变量。
questions.answerEn: The outcome is bmi. The grouping variable is sex.
questions.answerZh: bmi为结果变量，sex为分组变量。
questions.explanationZh: 公式左侧为本例比较的数值指标，右侧为两组类别。

questions.promptEn: What does Cohen’s d describe in the BMI analysis?
questions.promptZh: BMI分析中的Cohen’s d表示什么？
questions.answerEn: The mean difference in pooled-standard-deviation units.
questions.answerZh: 以合并标准差为单位的均值差。
questions.explanationZh: d衡量标准化差异大小；p值用于假设检验证据。
options: The probability that H₀ is true
The number of people with high BMI
The mean difference in pooled-standard-deviation units
A BMI difference measured directly in kg/m²

questions.promptEn: What does capture.output({...}, file = "results.txt") save in this script?
questions.promptZh: 本章脚本中capture.output({...}, file = "results.txt")保存什么？
questions.answerEn: It saves the text printed by the expressions to a text file.
questions.answerZh: 把这些表达式打印出的文字结果保存为文本文件。
questions.explanationZh: 本页将描述统计、t检验输出和Cohen’s d放入可复核报告；它不自动等于保存模型对象。
rubric: 说明捕获打印/控制台文字（1分）

questions.promptEn: The BMI t-test gives p = .3257. At α = .05, which statement is correct?
questions.promptZh: BMI检验p=.3257，α=.05，正确结论是什么？
questions.answerEn: Fail to reject H₀; the mean difference is not statistically significant.
questions.answerZh: 不拒绝H₀；均值差在该阈值下不显著。
questions.explanationZh: p>.05是证据不足，不是证明两组总体均值完全相等。
options: Prove that all male and female BMI values are equal
Reject H₀ because the male sample mean is larger
Fail to reject H₀; the mean difference is not statistically significant
Conclude that p is the effect size

questions.promptEn: What does the thick line inside each standard boxplot represent?
questions.promptZh: 标准箱线图箱内的粗线代表什么？
questions.answerEn: The median.
questions.answerZh: 中位数。
questions.explanationZh: t检验比较均值，但箱内线通常显示中位数；读图时不要混淆。

questions.promptEn: PHQ-9 mean scores are 6.05 (No vaccination) and 5.61 (Yes), with p = .1081. Give a one-sentence conclusion at α = .05.
questions.promptZh: PHQ-9未接种组均值6.05、已接种组5.61，p=.1081，写一句结论。
questions.answerEn: The study does not show a statistically significant mean PHQ-9 difference between the groups at α = .05.
questions.answerZh: 在α=.05下，该资料未显示两组PHQ-9均值存在统计显著差异。
questions.explanationZh: 可以报告样本均值方向，但不能由此证明接种有心理健康保护效果。
rubric: 针对PHQ-9两组均值、限定该资料（1分）

questions.promptEn: For SBP, p = 2.211e-10. Which statement is correct at α = .05?
questions.promptZh: 血压结果p=2.211e-10，在α=.05下哪项正确？
questions.answerEn: Reject H₀; there is strong statistical evidence of a mean difference.
questions.answerZh: 拒绝H₀；均值差存在强统计证据。
questions.explanationZh: 科学计数法e-10表示乘10⁻¹⁰，非常小但不是0。
options: Fail to reject H₀ because the t-statistic is negative
Reject H₀; there is strong statistical evidence of a mean difference
The result proves hypertension causes the observed difference

questions.promptEn: Which healthcare question fits the chi-square applications on slide 48?
questions.promptZh: 哪项符合第48页的卡方检验医疗应用？
questions.answerEn: Is satisfied/dissatisfied status associated with hospital department?
questions.answerZh: 满意/不满意状态是否与医院部门有关？
questions.explanationZh: 满意状态与部门都为类别；其他选项均为数值均值问题。
options: Does average BMI differ between two independent groups?
Does mean blood pressure differ before and after treatment?
Is satisfied/dissatisfied status associated with hospital department?
What is the mean age of all patients?

questions.promptEn: Name the purposes of table(), chisq.test() and Cramér’s V in the vaccination analysis.
questions.promptZh: 在接种状态分析中，分别说出table()、chisq.test()与Cramér’s V的用途。
questions.answerEn: table() creates category counts. chisq.test() tests independence. Cramér’s V describes association strength.
questions.answerZh: table()生成交叉计数；chisq.test()检验独立性；Cramér’s V描述关联强度。
questions.explanationZh: 三者是数据整理、显著性检验及效应量，不能互相替代。

questions.promptEn: Diabetes status by race/ethnicity gives p = .8225. Which conclusion is justified?
questions.promptZh: 糖尿病状态与族裔的卡方p=.8225，哪项结论合理？
questions.answerEn: There is insufficient evidence of association in this dataset at α = .05.
questions.answerZh: 在α=.05下，该资料的关联证据不足。
questions.explanationZh: 原图Proves表述过强；不显著不证明独立，也不证明所有组患病率完全相同。
rubric: 选择证据不足的结论（1分）
options: Race/ethnicity can never be related to diabetes
All groups have exactly the same risk
H₀ has an 82.25% probability of being true
There is insufficient evidence of association in this dataset at α = .05

questions.promptEn: Use the BMI output: male mean 27.48259, female mean 27.15697, p = .3257, 95% CI for Male − Female = [−.3245018, .9757476], d = .08059824. Calculate the sample mean difference and write a careful interpretation.
questions.promptZh: 根据BMI输出计算均值差，并结合p值、95%区间和d写审慎解释。
questions.answerEn: Male − Female = 0.32562 BMI units. The difference is not statistically significant at .05. The confidence interval includes zero and allows a small difference in either direction. The standardized difference is small. This does not prove equal population means.
questions.answerZh: 男性减女性=0.32562个BMI单位；p=.3257，不显著。95%区间包含0，仍允许小幅正向或负向差异；d约.081，标准化差异小，不能证明总体均值相等。
questions.explanationZh: 数值来自原图。区间跨0与双侧检验不显著一致，方向不能仅看正的样本均值差。
rubric: 区间包含0及方向不确定（1分）

questions.promptEn: For the BMI example, use mean Male = 27.48259, mean Female = 27.15697 and pooled SD = 4.040075. Calculate Cohen’s d and interpret its sign and size.
questions.promptZh: 用原例的两组均值和合并SD=4.040075计算Cohen’s d，解释正负与大小。
questions.answerEn: d = (27.48259 − 27.15697) / 4.040075 ≈ 0.0806. The positive sign means the male sample mean is higher. Its magnitude is small.
questions.explanationZh: 数值来自第23–24页，差异是约0.081个合并标准差，不是8.1%的BMI变化。
rubric: 大小很小且非百分比（1分）

questions.promptEn: A student says: “df = 578.09 must be an error because degrees of freedom must be whole numbers.” Use the named test in the BMI output to respond.
questions.promptZh: 学生说df=578.09一定错误，因为自由度必须是整数。根据输出中的检验名称回应。
questions.answerEn: The output names a Welch two-sample t-test. Welch uses an approximate degrees-of-freedom calculation, so a non-integer df is expected and is not by itself an error.
questions.answerZh: 输出明确是Welch双样本t检验；它使用近似自由度，出现非整数df是正常现象，不能单据小数认定错误。
questions.explanationZh: 这是对原图Welch结果的解释。不能擅自把df改成270+330−2，因为那是不同的等方差检验计算。
rubric: 近似自由度可非整数（1分）

questions.promptEn: The BMI boxplots overlap. A manager states: “This proves there is no BMI difference between sexes, and no further study is useful.” Identify two errors and write a better statement.
questions.promptZh: BMI箱线图重叠，经理称这证明性别间无差异且不必再研究。指出两点错误并改写。
questions.answerEn: Plot overlap is not proof of equal means. A non-significant test also does not prove no difference or settle future research needs. Better: In this sample, the distributions overlap and the t-test does not show a significant mean difference (p = .3257); uncertainty remains.
questions.answerZh: 图形重叠不能证明均值相等；不显著也不能证明无差异或直接否定进一步研究。可改为：本样本分布重叠，t检验未发现显著均值差异（p=.3257），仍存在不确定性。
questions.explanationZh: 第26页把图与输出并列，目的是相互解释，不是让读图替代推断。
rubric: 指出图重叠不是证明（1分）
指出不显著不等于无差异（1分）
报告p或适当检验结论（1分）
避免决定未来研究的过度断言（1分）

questions.promptEn: Slide 34 is titled PHQ-9 by vaccination, but its speaker note repeats “higher BMI.” Which variables should your answer use, and why? State the correct hypotheses for this page.
questions.promptZh: 第34页主题是接种状态与PHQ-9，但备注重复higher BMI。答题应使用什么变量，为什么？写出正确假设。
questions.answerEn: Use PHQ-9 as the outcome and vaccination status (No/Yes) as the grouping variable, because these match the page title, code and numerical output. H₀: μNo = μYes for PHQ-9; H₁: μNo ≠ μYes. The repeated BMI note is a topic mismatch.
questions.answerZh: 应以PHQ-9为结果、接种No/Yes为分组，因为与标题、代码及输出一致。H₀：两接种组总体PHQ-9均值相等；H₁：不相等。重复BMI的备注属于主题不匹配。
questions.explanationZh: 此题练习核对来源，不能把另一变量的备注机械套入。
rubric: 正确分组并说明来源核对（1分）
双侧H₁正确并识别备注问题（1分）

questions.promptEn: PHQ-9 output: No mean = 6.051020; Yes mean = 5.608911; p = .1081; 95% CI for No − Yes = [−.09764409, .98186312]; d = .1399513. A report says vaccination reduces depression. Evaluate it using the estimate, uncertainty and study design.
questions.promptZh: 结合PHQ-9均值、p、区间与d，评估“接种疫苗降低抑郁”的报告。
questions.answerEn: The observed mean difference is about 0.4421 points (No − Yes). It is not significant at .05, and the interval crosses zero. d is small. These observational group comparisons do not establish that vaccination reduces depression; other group differences may matter.
questions.answerZh: 观察均值差约.4421分；p>.05，区间跨0，d约.14较小。这种观察性组间比较不能证明接种降低抑郁，其他组间差异可能影响结果。
questions.explanationZh: 即使未来p显著，因果推断仍需要研究设计与混杂因素方面的支持。

questions.promptEn: SBP means are 114.1467 (No hypertension) and 127.0732 (Yes). Calculate No − Yes. Explain why d = −1.202495 can describe a large difference.
questions.promptZh: 血压No组均值114.1467、Yes组127.0732。计算No−Yes，并解释d为负为什么仍可代表较大差异。
questions.answerEn: No − Yes = −12.9265 mmHg. The sign means the No group has lower mean SBP. Effect-size magnitude uses |d| ≈ 1.20, so the standardized difference is large; reversing group order reverses the sign.
questions.answerZh: No−Yes=−12.9265 mmHg；负号表示No组更低。差异幅度看|d|≈1.20，因此标准化差异大；倒换相减顺序只改变符号。
questions.explanationZh: 原图数值仅受均值四舍五入影响；方向与Yes组箱体整体更高一致。

questions.promptEn: A team uses the SBP result p = 2.211 × 10⁻¹⁰ and d ≈ −1.20 to claim: “This test independently validates our hypertension diagnosis and proves the cause of high SBP.” Explain why this goes beyond the result.
questions.promptZh: 团队用血压显著结果宣称独立验证诊断且证明高血压数值的原因。解释为何超出结果。
questions.answerEn: The test shows a mean SBP difference between the recorded groups, not diagnostic accuracy or causation. Hypertension labels may already depend on blood pressure. Diagnostic validation needs suitable independent reference evidence, and causal claims need an appropriate study design.
questions.answerZh: 检验只显示已记录两组的均值差异，不直接检验诊断准确性或因果。高血压标签可能本就依据血压；诊断验证需要适当独立参照，因果结论需要合适设计。
questions.explanationZh: 第45页原文存在“validating”过度表述，本题要求把统计发现与临床解释边界分开。
rubric: 指出标签可能与SBP定义相关（1分）
诊断验证需要独立证据（1分）

questions.promptEn: A generated 4-by-2 contingency table has N = 600 and χ² = 12. Use V = sqrt(χ² / [N × (min(r,c) − 1)]) to calculate Cramér’s V. Does V alone give the p-value?
questions.promptZh: 模拟4×2列联表N=600、χ²=12。用给定公式计算Cramér’s V，并说明它能否直接给出p值。
questions.answerEn: V = sqrt(12 / [600 × (2 − 1)]) = sqrt(.02) ≈ .1414. V describes association strength; it is not a p-value.
questions.explanationZh: 此数值为原创模拟例子；公式来自第54页。min(4,2)=2，不能误用4。

questions.promptEn: Generated example: group A has 40 diabetes cases among 100 people; group B has 100 cases among 500 people. Which group has more cases, which has the higher case proportion, and why do raw bars mislead?
questions.promptZh: 模拟：A组100人中40例，B组500人中100例。哪组病例多、哪组比例高？为什么只看人数会误导？
questions.answerEn: B has more cases (100 vs 40). A has the higher proportion: 40/100 = 40%, versus 100/500 = 20%. Raw counts mix group size with the outcome proportion.
questions.answerZh: B组病例更多；A组比例40%，B组20%，所以A组比例更高。原始人数同时受组样本量影响，不能直接当患病比例。
questions.explanationZh: 原创模拟数据，用于第68页按族裔人数图的读图原则；不能凭这些数据单独推断统计显著性。
rubric: 说明分母差异/不能仅凭柱高推风险（1分）

questions.promptEn: Rewrite this slide-68 claim accurately: “p = .8225 proves diabetes status is independent of race/ethnicity, so race/ethnicity must never guide future research.”
questions.promptZh: 准确改写第68页延伸出的过度结论：p=.8225证明独立，因此未来不能研究族裔。
questions.answerEn: At α = .05, this dataset does not provide sufficient evidence of an association between diabetes status and race/ethnicity. It does not prove independence or determine all future research priorities.
questions.answerZh: 在α=.05下，这份资料未提供足够的关联证据；这不能证明独立，也不能单独决定所有未来研究方向。
questions.explanationZh: 统计判断限定于当前资料、检验条件和阈值；管理或研究决策还需其他证据。
rubric: 证据不足而非证明独立（1分）
不直接排除未来研究（1分）

questions.promptEn: Generated smoking–bronchitis analysis: chi-square p = .03, Cramér’s V = .04, with adequate test conditions. A report calls this a “strong causal link.” Evaluate significance, strength and causality separately.
questions.promptZh: 模拟吸烟与支气管炎分析p=.03、V=.04，检验条件适用。分别评估显著性、强度和因果。
questions.answerEn: At α = .05 the association is statistically significant. V = .04 indicates a very small association magnitude. Neither the p-value nor V establishes causality. “Strong causal link” is not supported by this test alone.
questions.answerZh: p<.05说明关联统计显著；V=.04表示关联幅度很小；两者均不能单独证明因果，因此“强因果联系”不成立。
questions.explanationZh: 原创模拟结果，针对第48页把小p直接说成strong association的表述；不能把统计显著、强度与因果混在一起。
rubric: 拒绝strong causal link并解释角色不同（1分）

questions.promptEn: For the same two-sided BMI analysis, reversing factor levels changes the comparison from Male − Female to Female − Male. Which change is expected?
questions.promptZh: 同一双侧BMI分析反转因子水平，比较由Male−Female变成Female−Male。预期哪项变化？
questions.answerEn: The estimated difference, t and signed d reverse sign; the two-sided p-value stays the same.
questions.answerZh: 均值差、t与有符号d反号；双侧p值不变。
questions.explanationZh: 同一资料交换两组不会改变双侧证据强度，区间也按新方向反号并交换端点。
rubric: 选对方向变而双侧p不变（2分）
options: Only the sample sizes become zero
The estimated difference, t and signed d reverse sign; the two-sided p-value stays the same
A non-significant result must become significant

questions.promptEn: The slide-23 effect-size code uses mean(), sd() and length() on group vectors. In a new dataset, some BMI entries are NA. Why might the t-test return a result but manual d be NA? How should you make the analysis consistent?
questions.promptZh: 第23页手动d代码用mean、sd、length。新资料有BMI缺失，为什么t检验可能有结果而d为NA？如何保持一致？
questions.answerEn: The manual mean() and sd() calls can return NA when the vectors contain missing values. Clean the intended complete cases once, then use those same group vectors for the test, valid counts, means, SDs and d. Do not use length() as a non-missing count before cleaning.
questions.answerZh: 手动mean、sd遇缺失可能返回NA。应先按分析所需变量统一筛选完整记录，再用同一批组内向量计算检验、有效人数、均值、SD和d；清理前length不等于非缺失人数。
questions.explanationZh: 这是对原代码的模拟数据质量延伸，原图不能证明没有缺失；关键在一致的分析样本，不能只随便删某一项结果。
rubric: 检验与效应量使用相同样本（1分）

questions.promptEn: A hospital asks three questions: (a) mean BMI by two independent sex groups; (b) vaccination status by neighborhood; (c) mean PHQ-9 by four independent income categories. Choose a method for each and justify it using variable types.

studyNotes.title: Sex as a factor / 类别变量与参照组
studyNotes.explanationZh: factor() 告诉 R 将 Sex 作为类别处理，并通过参照组进行比较。应检查实际模型所用数据中的 levels() 和编码说明，确认每个类别代表什么。通常默认以第一个水平为参照组；改变参照组会改变系数的表达，但在同一模型和数据下不会改变拟合值。
studyNotes.simpleEn: Use a factor for clear category comparisons. Check the levels and the reference group.
examFocus: 读懂 data$Sex <- factor(data$Sex)。
参照组是类别系数的比较基准。
核查变量定义，不能仅凭 Sex 这个名称推断其全部含义。
studyNotes.pitfall: 原页把 factor 说成必要条件，表述较绝对。两个类别采用数值编码且模型含截距时，也可能得到等价拟合；重点是明确类别和比较方式，不能把代码 2 解释为代码 1 的两倍。

studyNotes.title: Simple linear regression model / 简单线性回归模型
studyNotes.explanationZh: 模型 Y = β₀ + β₁X + ε：Y 是连续结果，X 是一个预测变量，β₀ 是 X=0 时的期望结果，β₁ 是 X 每增加 1 单位时结果的平均变化，ε 是个体结果与模型均值之间的误差。估计后的预测式写作 ŷ = b₀ + b₁x，不把未知个体误差直接加进点预测。
studyNotes.simpleEn: Simple regression links one predictor to a continuous outcome. The slope is the average change in Y for one unit of X.
examFocus: 识别 X、Y、截距、斜率、误差项。
区分平均预测值与某个个体的实际结果。
X=0 可能超出数据范围，截距未必有实际解释。
studyNotes.pitfall: 该页讲者备注重复介绍输出文件夹，未解释模型。这里根据本页图中公式整理；回归关系本身不能证明因果。
studyNotes.visualExplanation: 图中公式为 Y = β₀ + β₁X + ε；血压可作为 Y，年龄可作为 X。

studyNotes.title: Age and systolic BP hypotheses / 年龄与收缩压的假设
studyNotes.explanationZh: 研究年龄能否线性预测收缩压。Age 为连续预测变量 X，SystolicBP 为连续结果 Y。双侧检验 H₀: β₁=0；H₁: β₁≠0，检验总体线性斜率是否为零。H₀ 不等于“两个变量不存在任何形式关系”，因为非线性关系仍可能存在。
studyNotes.simpleEn: Age is X and systolic BP is Y. Test H0: slope = 0 against H1: slope ≠ 0.
examFocus: 写出回归斜率的零假设和双侧备择假设。
分清预测变量与结果变量。
显著性不等于预测精度或因果效应。
studyNotes.pitfall: 图片把备择假设称为“significant relationship”，更严谨的写法是总体斜率不等于零；是否显著由样本检验结果判断。
studyNotes.visualExplanation: 图片列出 X=Age、Y=SystolicBP，并写出 β₁=0 与 β₁≠0。

studyNotes.title: Read regression output / 读懂回归输出
studyNotes.explanationZh: 原图使用 500 个观测。拟合式为 SBP_hat = 122.84028 + 0.37425×Age。年龄每增加 1 岁，拟合平均 SBP 增加约 0.37425 mmHg；年龄斜率 95% CI 为 [0.3048319, 0.4436753]，p<2e−16。R²=0.1839，表示本模型在这批数据中解释约 18.39% 的 SBP 变异。很小的 p 值与有限的解释力可以同时存在。
studyNotes.simpleEn: Each extra year of age is associated with about 0.374 mmHg higher mean SBP. The model explains 18.39% of the observed variation.
examFocus: 从 Estimate 读出截距和斜率，并代入预测。
结合系数、95% CI、p 值、n、R²说明结果。
原图残差标准误约 9.234 mmHg，不能当成每人的准确误差。
studyNotes.pitfall: R² 不是“18.39% 的患者预测正确”，p 极小也不代表年龄足以准确预测每个患者。图中的 Multiple R-squared 是 R 的常用输出名称，此处仍为只有一个预测变量的简单回归。
studyNotes.visualExplanation: 散点图红线向上，但点在直线两侧仍较分散。左侧表有 n=500、斜率 0.37425、R²=0.1839 与斜率置信区间。

studyNotes.title: Residuals versus fitted / 残差对拟合值图
studyNotes.explanationZh: 检查模型是否遗漏明显曲线趋势，以及残差的垂直散布是否大致稳定。理想情况是残差围绕零随机分布，平滑线大致水平。明显 U 形或弯曲趋势提示线性形式可能不足；漏斗形可能提示方差不恒定。原图平滑线大致在零附近，但末端略有下降，应谨慎解释。
studyNotes.simpleEn: Look for random residuals around zero. A curved pattern may suggest a poor linear form.
examFocus: 识别残差 = observed − fitted。
解释曲线形状、漏斗形状、零线附近随机散点。
图形诊断提供支持证据，不能证明假设完全成立。
studyNotes.pitfall: 原文“confirms ... no hidden non-linear curve”过强。应答为“未见明显违背线性的证据”或“与近似线性相容”，并结合数据与其他诊断。
studyNotes.visualExplanation: 四联图的左上角是 Residuals vs Fitted；本页重点读这一幅，不凭其他面板替代判断。

studyNotes.title: Scale-location / 方差是否大致恒定
studyNotes.explanationZh: Scale-Location 图横轴为拟合值，纵轴为标准化残差绝对值的平方根。若散布宽度相近且平滑线大致水平，则与误差方差近似恒定相容。若向右明显上升或逐渐张开，提示高拟合值处残差变异可能更大。原图红线略向上，不能断言完全恒定。
studyNotes.simpleEn: A roughly flat scale-location trend supports similar error variance. A rising trend may suggest increasing variance.
examFocus: 将 homoscedasticity 解释为误差方差近似恒定。
与 Residuals vs Fitted 图结合判断。
图横轴是拟合值，不能无条件改写为年龄。
studyNotes.pitfall: 原页“proves homoscedasticity”以及“younger or older errors are consistent”过强。诊断不能证明假设；在这个只有年龄的正斜率模型中，拟合值与年龄对应，但不能推广到所有模型。
studyNotes.visualExplanation: 四联图的左下角是 Scale-Location。红色平滑线有轻微上升，适合练习谨慎判断，而不是背“完全水平”。

studyNotes.title: Saved outputs and run order / 保存结果与执行依赖
studyNotes.explanationZh: 应保存回归摘要、ANOVA 表、散点图、诊断图、系数表、置信区间、预测值及残差、正态性检验，并记录输出位置。保存结果帮助追踪分析过程，但完整复现还需要数据、脚本和执行环境。脚本后段依赖前段对象，宜按顺序运行：4B/4C 依赖已加载的数据和输出文件夹；5B–5D 依赖 5A；第 6 节依赖简单与多元模型都已建立。
studyNotes.simpleEn: Save the analysis outputs and run dependent sections in order. A clean session helps reveal missing objects.
examFocus: 输出文件夹与审计记录的作用。
根据报错和对象依赖判断应先运行哪一节。
不能把“某段代码能运行”等同于“独立、可复现”。
studyNotes.pitfall: 仅保留截图或最终 p 值不足以重现分析；旧会话里残留对象可能使跳步运行看似成功。

studyNotes.title: Crude versus adjusted associations / 粗关联与调整后关联
studyNotes.explanationZh: 简单回归描述年龄与 SBP 的粗关联；多元回归在考虑模型中其他预测变量后估计各变量的调整后关联。报告需要效应估计、95% CI、p 值、样本量、模型拟合与诊断，并说明缺失数据、未测量混杂、测量问题、研究设计和合成数据的限制。调整已测量变量不能自动消除全部混杂。
studyNotes.simpleEn: Simple regression gives a crude association. Multiple regression gives an association adjusted for the other included predictors. Association does not prove causation.
examFocus: 用“holding other included predictors constant”解释调整后系数。
报告效应大小与不确定性，不只报告显著性。
合成数据用于学习，不用于直接制定临床或政策决策。
studyNotes.pitfall: 多元回归不能自动证明因果。调整后系数变化可能与纳入变量或分析样本变化有关，不能单凭变化就证明某变量是混杂因素。

questions.promptEn: What is the main purpose of data$Sex <- factor(data$Sex)?
questions.promptZh: 这行 R 代码的主要作用是什么？
questions.answerEn: B. Tell R to treat Sex as a categorical variable.
questions.answerZh: B。将 Sex 明确作为类别变量。
questions.explanationZh: factor 用类别水平表达组别；它不会自动核实原始编码是否正确。
options: Multiply each Sex value by a factor.
Tell R to treat Sex as a categorical variable.
Remove all rows with missing Sex.
Prove that Sex is a continuous measure.

questions.promptEn: Why should you check factor levels before reading a category coefficient?
questions.promptZh: 解释类别系数前，为什么要检查 factor 的 levels？
questions.answerEn: Check the category coding and the reference group. The coefficient compares a category with that reference.
questions.answerZh: 检查类别编码和参照组；类别系数表示相对参照组的差异。
questions.explanationZh: 通常第一个水平为默认参照组，但需要核实实际模型的编码设置。
rubric: 指出检查类别编码/水平 1 分
指出参照组与比较含义 1 分

questions.promptEn: In simple regression of SBP on age, which is the outcome?
questions.promptZh: 以年龄预测收缩压时，结果变量是什么？
questions.answerEn: C. Systolic blood pressure.
questions.answerZh: C。收缩压。
questions.explanationZh: Age 为 X，连续的 SystolicBP 为 Y；一个预测变量构成简单线性回归。

questions.promptEn: State what β0 and β1 mean in Y = β0 + β1X + ε.
questions.promptZh: 说明模型中的 β₀ 与 β₁ 分别表示什么。
questions.answerEn: β0 is the expected Y at X = 0. β1 is the average change in Y for a one-unit increase in X.
questions.answerZh: β₀ 是 X=0 时 Y 的期望值；β₁ 是 X 增加 1 单位时 Y 的平均变化。
questions.explanationZh: 斜率要带上 X 和 Y 的单位；截距是否有实际意义取决于 X=0 是否合理。
rubric: 正确解释单位斜率 1 分

questions.promptEn: Which pair is correct for a two-sided test of the age slope?
questions.promptZh: 检验年龄斜率的双侧假设，哪组正确？
questions.answerZh: A。零假设为斜率等于零，备择为不等于零。
questions.explanationZh: 假设针对总体参数，而不是样本中某条直线是否向上。
options: H0: age = SBP; H1: age ≠ SBP.

questions.promptEn: The slide gives SBP_hat = 122.84028 + 0.37425 × Age. Calculate fitted mean SBP at age 50.
questions.promptZh: 使用原页回归式，计算 50 岁时的拟合平均收缩压。
questions.explanationZh: 这是模型的平均点预测，不代表每位 50 岁患者的实际血压都等于这个值。
rubric: 说明是拟合平均值并给单位，1 分

questions.promptEn: Interpret the age coefficient 0.37425 in one sentence.
questions.promptZh: 用一句话解释年龄系数 0.37425。
questions.answerEn: Each extra year of age is associated with about 0.37425 mmHg higher mean SBP in this simple model.
questions.answerZh: 在这个简单模型中，年龄每增加 1 岁，平均 SBP 约高 0.37425 mmHg。
questions.explanationZh: 这是粗关联；不能把“associated with”改成“causes”。
rubric: 说明每增加 1 岁的平均变化 1 分
方向、数值和单位正确且用关联表述 1 分

questions.promptEn: The output reports R² = 0.1839. Which interpretation is correct?
questions.promptZh: R²=0.1839，哪项解释正确？
questions.answerEn: D. The model explains 18.39% of the observed SBP variation.
questions.answerZh: D。模型解释这批数据中约 18.39% 的 SBP 变异。
questions.explanationZh: 解释变异比例不是分类准确率，也不是因果贡献比例。
options: 18.39% of patients have a correct diagnosis.
Age causes exactly 18.39% of all hypertension.
The model explains 18.39% of the observed SBP variation.

questions.promptEn: Which pattern is most compatible with a suitable linear form in a residuals-versus-fitted plot?
questions.promptZh: 哪种残差对拟合值图形与合理的线性形式较相容？
questions.answerEn: B. Random points around zero with no clear curve.
questions.answerZh: B。点在零附近随机散布，没有明显曲线。
questions.explanationZh: 这是支持线性形式的证据，不能证明所有模型假设都成立。
options: Random points around zero with no clear curve.

questions.promptEn: What does homoscedasticity mean?
questions.promptZh: 什么是 homoscedasticity（同方差性）？
questions.answerEn: The error variance is roughly constant across the range of predictors or fitted values.
questions.answerZh: 在预测变量或拟合值的范围内，误差方差大致恒定。
questions.explanationZh: 恒定的是误差分布的方差，不是要求每个患者误差完全相同。
rubric: 说明随拟合值/预测变量范围大致恒定 1 分

questions.promptEn: Which output is useful for checking a regression model rather than only its coefficient significance?
questions.promptZh: 除系数显著性外，哪种输出有助于检查回归模型？
questions.answerEn: C. Diagnostic plots.
questions.answerZh: C。诊断图。
questions.explanationZh: 诊断图可发现残差趋势或方差问题；仅一个 p 值不能完成模型检查。
options: Only the name of the CSV file.

questions.promptEn: Why should the script sections be run in order?
questions.promptZh: 为什么应按顺序运行脚本各节？
questions.answerEn: Later sections use data, folders or model objects created earlier. Running in order avoids missing or stale objects.
questions.answerZh: 后面的代码依赖前面创建的数据、文件夹或模型对象；顺序运行可避免对象缺失或使用旧对象。
questions.explanationZh: 例如 5B–5D 依赖 5A，第 6 节依赖简单与多元模型均已存在。
rubric: 指出后段依赖前段对象 1 分
说明避免缺失/旧对象或给出具体依赖 1 分

questions.promptEn: Which statement best describes multiple regression here?
questions.promptZh: 本章中，多元回归的正确含义是哪项？
questions.answerEn: A. It estimates associations after accounting for other included predictors.
questions.answerZh: A。在考虑模型中其他预测变量后估计关联。
questions.explanationZh: 调整后关联仍取决于所纳入变量、测量和研究设计。
options: It estimates associations after accounting for other included predictors.
It automatically removes every possible confounder.
It proves that every significant predictor causes SBP.
It only works when the outcome is a category.

questions.promptEn: Name four items that should appear in a regression report.
questions.promptZh: 列出回归报告应包含的四项内容。
questions.answerEn: For example: effect estimate, 95% confidence interval, p-value and sample size. Also report model fit, diagnostics and limitations.
questions.answerZh: 例如：效应估计、95% 置信区间、p 值、样本量；还应报告模型拟合、诊断与限制。
questions.explanationZh: 不能只写“p<0.05，所以模型很好”。题目四项可从原页列表中任选正确项目。
rubric: 每个不同且正确的项目 1 分，最多 4 分

questions.promptEn: Can these synthetic results directly justify a clinical treatment policy?
questions.promptZh: 这份合成数据的结果能否直接用于制定临床治疗政策？
questions.answerEn: D. No. They are for learning and do not provide direct clinical evidence.
questions.answerZh: D。不可以，它们用于学习，不能直接提供临床决策证据。
questions.explanationZh: 原页明确标注 synthetic；统计显著性不能改变数据的教学性质。
options: Yes, because the p-value is very small.
Yes, because the model has a regression line.
No. They are for learning and do not provide direct clinical evidence.

questions.promptEn: An analyst changes the reference level of Sex but uses the same data and model terms. A category coefficient changes sign. Does this alone show that the underlying result changed? Explain.
questions.promptZh: 分析员更改 Sex 的参照组，数据与模型项不变，类别系数符号改变。这能否单独说明结果改变？请解释。
questions.answerEn: No. The comparison direction changed. Check which group is now the reference. With equivalent coding of the same model, fitted values stay the same.
questions.answerZh: 不能。比较方向改变了，应先检查新参照组。对同一模型作等价重新编码时，拟合值保持不变。
questions.explanationZh: 本题是根据 factor 与参照组概念设计的模拟情境。两组比较由 B−A 改为 A−B 时，符号可反转。
rubric: 说明不能仅由符号判断结果变化 1 分
说明参照组/比较方向改变 1 分
指出等价编码拟合值不变 1 分
提出核查 levels/参照组 1 分

questions.promptEn: A report says: “Sex is coded 1 and 2, so group 2 has twice the amount of Sex.” Identify the error and state two checks before modelling.
questions.promptZh: 报告写道：“Sex 编码为 1、2，因此第 2 组的 Sex 数量是第 1 组的两倍。”指出错误，并列出建模前两项检查。
questions.answerEn: The numbers are category labels, not a meaningful ratio. Check the coding definitions and factor levels/reference group. Confirm what the variable actually measures.
questions.answerZh: 这些数字是类别标签，不能作有意义的倍数解释。应核查编码定义、类别水平及参照组，并确认变量实际测量的含义。
questions.explanationZh: 不能仅凭变量名推断生物或社会含义。二分类数值编码可能等价拟合，但“二倍 Sex”的解释仍不成立。
rubric: 指出标签不是倍数尺度 1 分
检查水平/参照组 1 分
确认实际测量含义 1 分

questions.promptEn: Using the slide model, calculate the fitted mean SBP difference between ages 60 and 50. Then calculate the corresponding 95% CI by scaling the slope CI [0.3048319, 0.4436753].
questions.promptZh: 根据原页模型，计算 60 岁与 50 岁的拟合平均 SBP 差异，并将斜率区间换算为这一年龄差对应的 95% CI。
questions.explanationZh: 这是同一线性模型中 10 年年龄差的平均差异及区间。它不是单个患者血压的预测区间，也不是纵向因果变化。
rubric: 识别年龄差 10 年 1 分
正确计算平均差 1 分
正确计算两个区间端点各 1 分
区分平均关联与个人预测/因果 1 分

questions.promptEn: A hypothetical patient aged 60 has observed SBP 150 mmHg. Using the slide equation, calculate the fitted SBP and residual (observed − fitted).
questions.promptZh: 一位模拟的 60 岁患者实测 SBP 为 150 mmHg。按原页公式计算拟合值及残差（实测−拟合）。
questions.answerZh: 拟合值 145.29528 mmHg；残差 +4.70472 mmHg，表示实测值比拟合值高约 4.70 mmHg。
questions.explanationZh: 150 mmHg 为本题模拟值；模型系数来自原页。注意残差的正负方向。
rubric: 正确代入并求拟合值 1 分
解释正残差含义并给单位 1 分

questions.promptEn: The age p-value is <2e−16, but R² is 0.1839. A student concludes “Age gives highly accurate individual predictions.” Evaluate this conclusion.
questions.promptZh: 年龄 p<2e−16，而 R²=0.1839。有同学因此说年龄可以非常准确地预测个人血压。评价这个结论。
questions.answerEn: The conclusion is unsupported. The p-value supports a non-zero linear slope under the model assumptions. R² shows that only 18.39% of observed variation is explained. Individual prediction accuracy needs separate evaluation.
questions.answerZh: 结论没有充分依据。极小 p 值支持斜率非零；R² 表明仅解释约 18.39% 的样本变异。个人预测精度需要另行评估。
questions.explanationZh: 显著性关注是否有统计证据支持非零斜率；预测能力关注误差大小与泛化表现。散点仍明显分散。
rubric: 否定仅凭 p 值宣称准确 1 分
正确解释 p 值对应斜率检验 1 分
指出仍有大量未解释变异 1 分
提出独立评估预测误差/区间等 1 分

questions.promptEn: Using the source values Age estimate = 0.37425 and SE = 0.03533, calculate the approximate t statistic for H0: β1 = 0. Is it consistent with the printed t = 10.59?
questions.promptZh: 使用原图估计值与标准误计算 H₀: β₁=0 的近似 t 统计量，并核对原图的 10.59。
questions.answerEn: t = (0.37425 − 0) / 0.03533 ≈ 10.59. Yes, it agrees after rounding.
questions.answerZh: t≈10.59，与原图四舍五入后一致。
questions.explanationZh: 利用本页输出中的 Estimate、Std. Error 与 t value 的关系；并不需要把极小 p 值写成零。
rubric: 正确写出估计值除以标准误 1 分
说明四舍五入一致 1 分

questions.promptEn: The 95% CI for the age slope is [0.3048319, 0.4436753]. State the direction, whether zero is included, and what it means for the two-sided slope test at 5%. Do not claim causation.
questions.promptZh: 根据年龄斜率的 95% CI，说明方向、是否包含零，以及与 5% 双侧检验的关系，避免作因果解释。
questions.answerEn: The interval is positive and excludes zero. It supports a positive age–SBP association and rejection of H0: β1 = 0 at 5%, under the model assumptions.
questions.answerZh: 区间全为正且不含零，在模型假设下支持正的年龄—SBP 关联，并与 5% 双侧检验拒绝零斜率假设一致。
questions.explanationZh: 不能解释为“这个固定区间有 95% 概率包含固定真实参数”，也不能推断年龄造成血压升高。
rubric: 对应拒绝双侧零斜率假设 1 分
注明关联/模型假设且避免因果 1 分

questions.promptEn: A residuals-versus-fitted plot has a clear U-shaped smooth line. Another plot has no curve but a strong funnel-shaped spread. Explain the different concerns.
questions.promptZh: 第一张残差图有明显 U 形平滑线；另一张没有曲线但散布呈明显漏斗形。分别指出关注的问题。
questions.answerEn: The U shape suggests the linear mean relationship may be inadequate. The funnel suggests non-constant error variance. These concern different assumptions and may occur separately.
questions.answerZh: U 形提示均值关系可能不适合简单直线；漏斗形提示误差方差可能不恒定。两种问题不同，也可能分别出现。
questions.explanationZh: 本题为诊断图原则衍生的模拟情境，不是声称原图存在明显 U 形或强漏斗。
rubric: U 形与线性形式问题 1 分
漏斗与方差不恒定问题 1 分
明确两者检查不同方面 1 分
用提示/可能而非证明作答 1 分

questions.promptEn: Rewrite this claim more carefully: “The scale-location plot proves constant variance for all patients.”
questions.promptZh: 把“Scale-Location 图证明所有患者的误差方差都恒定”改成严谨表述。
questions.answerEn: A roughly flat trend and similar spread support approximately constant error variance over the observed fitted-value range. The plot does not prove the assumption.
questions.answerZh: 平滑线大致水平且散布相近，可支持在观测到的拟合值范围内误差方差近似恒定；图形不能证明该假设。
questions.explanationZh: 原图红线还有轻微上升，应结合其他诊断观察可能的方差趋势。不能宣称“所有患者”都已被证明。
rubric: 改为支持/相容而非证明 1 分
说明近似恒定误差方差 1 分
限制在观测拟合值范围或承认图形局限 1 分

questions.promptEn: A student opens a fresh R session and runs Section 6 first. The code fails because model objects are missing. The same code worked yesterday. Explain the likely reason and give a reproducible recovery plan.
questions.promptZh: 学生在新 R 会话中首先运行第 6 节，因模型对象不存在而失败；昨天同样代码能运行。解释原因，并给出可复现的恢复步骤。
questions.answerEn: Yesterday the session may have contained old model objects. Start from the data-loading and setup sections, create the required simple and multiple models in order, then run Section 6 and verify the saved outputs.
questions.answerZh: 昨天会话可能残留模型对象。应从载入数据与设置开始，按顺序建立简单和多元模型，再运行第 6 节并核查保存输出。
questions.explanationZh: 脚本分节不代表每节独立。干净会话可暴露依赖，帮助防止把旧模型误当本次结果。
rubric: 说明旧会话残留对象的可能性 1 分
指出第 6 节依赖两种模型 1 分
先运行数据与设置 1 分
按依赖顺序建立模型再运行 1 分
核查保存输出/清洁会话复现 1 分

questions.promptEn: A regression folder contains only one screenshot showing p < 0.001. Is this a sufficient analysis record? Name four additional items to save or document.
questions.promptZh: 分析文件夹只保留一张 p<0.001 的截图。记录是否充分？另列四项应保存或记录的内容。
questions.answerEn: No. Save or document the script and data version, regression estimates and CIs, diagnostic plots, and predicted values/residuals. Also record sample size and the output location.
questions.answerZh: 不充分。可保存脚本与数据版本、回归估计及区间、诊断图、预测值和残差；还应记录样本量与输出位置。
questions.explanationZh: 四项可从原页输出列表及复现所需材料中合理选择。保存全部截图仍不能替代数据和脚本。
rubric: 每项不同且正确的补充材料 1 分，最多 4 分

questions.promptEn: A simple model gives an age coefficient of 0.50. A multiple model gives 0.30 after including BMI and Sex. These are invented practice values. Interpret both coefficients and state why the change alone does not prove causation or confounding.
questions.promptZh: 模拟数据中，简单模型年龄系数为 0.50；加入 BMI 与 Sex 后为 0.30。分别解释两个系数，并说明为何系数变化本身不能证明因果或混杂。
questions.answerEn: The crude age association is 0.50 mmHg per year. The adjusted association is 0.30 mmHg per year, holding the included BMI and Sex terms constant. The change alone does not establish a causal effect or prove confounding; model specification and the analysis sample also matter.
questions.answerZh: 粗关联为每岁 0.50 mmHg；在保持模型中的 BMI 与 Sex 项不变时，调整后关联为每岁 0.30 mmHg。变化本身不能证明因果或混杂，还要检查模型和分析样本。

Code: 
data$Sex <- factor(data$Sex)
Treats sex as a category, not a number
Allows R to compare groups appropriately
Necessary for the multiple regression model
slides.notes:
A factor is R’s way of identifying a categorical variable. This matters because categories should not automatically be treated as numerical values.
For example, if sex were coded as 1 and 2, treating it as a number would imply that “2 is twice 1,” which is not meaningful. Converting it to a factor tells R to create comparison indicators between categories.
The reference category is usually the first factor level. Students should check the levels with:
levels(multi_data$Sex)
The variable is called Sex in the dataset, but an analyst should confirm exactly what was measured and how it was coded. Do not assume that a variable labeled “Sex” captures gender identity, biology, or social experience in a complete way.

Simple Linear Regression

Simple Linear Regression is a foundational statistical method used to examine the relationship
between one independent variable (X) and a single continuous dependent variable (Y).

The basic mathematical model is expressed as:
Y=Bho+BiX +e
* Y:The target variable we want to predict or explain (e.g., blood pressure).
* X:The single predictor or independent variable (e.g., age).
* Bo: The intercept (the expected value of Ywhen X = 0).
* £,:The regression coefficient (the slope, representing the average change in Yfor a one-unit increase
in X).

* e€: The errorterm.
